config.jojoha.title: JoJo: Heaven's Arrow Settings
config.jojoha.sand_shade.tooltip: How strongly Crusader Sand shifts between lighter and darker patches across the Stardust Sands. 0 makes it one even colour. Reload chunks with F3+A to see a change.
config.jojoha.impact_frames.tooltip: Finishing blows flash the whole screen to black and white ink for a moment. Turn off to keep the screen from flashing.
config.jojoha.palette_swaps.tooltip: The whole world snaps to a different colour palette, with a sound, at the big moments: landing or taking a finishing blow, guard breaks, barrage clashes, the arrow or mask piercing you, a Stand awakening, your Stand collapsing and being revived.
config.jojoha.palette_strength.tooltip: How far the world shifts toward the swapped palette. Lower keeps more of the normal colours.
config.jojoha.gore.tooltip: Blood thrown whenever something is hurt. Light keeps a small spray. Full throws more, leaves stains that fade from blocks, and makes badly wounded creatures drip.
config.jojoha.summon_flair.tooltip: A ground ring, dust, aura flare and afterimages play when a Stand is summoned.
config.jojoha.camera_motion.tooltip: Blows throw the camera along the hit, shake it, and punch the view in. Turn off to keep the camera still.
config.jojoha.barrage_trails.tooltip: How many fading copies trail behind each barrage fist, blade or kick. 0 turns the trails off.
config.jojoha.barrage_trail_opacity.tool: How solid the barrage trails and the glow around barrage arms look.
config.jojoha.barrage_air.tooltip: Barrage blows puff the air, kick up dust and water under them, and whoosh. Turn off for a quieter barrage.
config.jojoha.barrage_recoil.tooltip: How much a Stand's body rocks with each blow and leans into a long barrage. 0 keeps it still. Also scales the small camera push and shake while your own Stand barrages.
config.jojoha.barrage_echo.tooltip: How many glowing copies of each fist linger for a tenth of a second behind it. 0 turns echoes off and brings back the older trails.
config.jojoha.barrage_phantoms.tooltip: Extra fists flicker in and out in a cone toward the target, as if the Stand is too fast to see.
config.jojoha.barrage_glow.tooltip: How strongly barrage arms, echoes and smears glow. They flare as a barrage starts, settle down as it goes on, and glow less in the dark. 0 turns the glow off.
config.jojoha.barrage_smears.tooltip: How bright the tapered streak behind each fist is. 0 turns smears off.
config.jojoha.impact_words.tooltip: Manga sound effects pop up on heavy hits, finishers, guard breaks and parries.
config.jojoha.barrage_words.tooltip: ORA, MUDA and the like pop up around a barraging Stand that has a battle cry.
config.jojoha.barrage_hit_sounds.tooltip: A rapid patter of hits plays under the battle cry while fists land.
config.jojoha.central_bar_mode.tooltip: Show the long combat bar across the middle of the screen over the hotbar, instead of the combat bar in the top left corner.
config.jojoha.reset.title: Reset every setting?
config.jojoha.reset.message: Your screen settings and this world's gameplay settings all go back to how the mod ships.
config.jojoha.reset.message.remote: Your screen settings go back to how the mod ships. The server's gameplay settings are not yours to reset.
config.jojoha.section.world.note: For worlds you host. A server owner sets these in config/jojoha-server.json, then runs /jojoha debug reload.
config.jojoha.section.world.remote: Set by the server you are playing on, so they can only be changed there.
config.jojoha.pvp_armour_curve.tooltip: When a Stand, Hamon, vampire power or a Stand-user mob hits a player, armour and Protection work exactly as in vanilla (Stands ignore half), but the hit always keeps at least the floor below. Plain weapon hits between players are never touched.
config.jojoha.pvp_armour_floor.tooltip: The least share of a power's hit that still lands on a player, however good their armour, in percent.
config.jojoha.bar_corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the combat bar sits in. Placed along the bottom, it rises clear of the hotbar when the two would overlap. Only used when Central Bar Mode is off.
config.jojoha.bar_offset_x.tooltip: Moves the combat bar left (negative) or right (positive) from its corner. It never leaves the screen.
config.jojoha.bar_offset_y.tooltip: Moves the combat bar up (negative) or down (positive) from its corner, to clear chat, effects or another mod's HUD.
config.jojoha.block_breaking.tooltip: Whether barrages and Emerald Splash break blocks. Follow Mob Griefing uses the mobGriefing game rule. Spawn protection and claims are respected either way.
config.jojoha.hardest_breakable.tooltip: The toughest block a Stand can break. Dirt is 0.5, stone 1.5, iron ore 3, iron block 5, obsidian 50.
config.jojoha.blocks_per_blow.tooltip: How many blocks a single barrage blow can break.
config.jojoha.mob_stand_spawn.tooltip: The chance that a naturally spawned mob that can hold a Stand spawns with one.
config.jojoha.stand_user_pull.tooltip: How much more often mobs spawn with a Stand within 64 blocks of a Stand user. A Warding Charm stops it for its wearer.
config.jojoha.stand_mob_health.tooltip: Extra health a mob gets when it gains a Stand, as a share of its normal health.
config.jojoha.stand_mob_armor.tooltip: Extra armor points a mob gets when it gains a Stand.
config.jojoha.anubis_bearer.tooltip: How rarely a naturally spawned mob near a worthy player rises carrying Anubis.
config.jojoha.vampire_weight.tooltip: How common vampires are among night monsters. A zombie is 95. 0 stops them spawning. Takes effect the next time a world loads.
config.jojoha.willow_chance.tooltip: The chance, every few minutes spent in the Phantom Moors, that Willow appears nearby.
config.jojoha.dream_chance.tooltip: The chance that sleeping in a bed takes you to the Dream.
config.jojoha.burn_damage.tooltip: Damage Burning deals each second at its first stack. Each further stack adds half again, up to three stacks. Water and Fire Resistance put it out.
config.jojoha.burn_ticks.tooltip: Ticks Burning lasts; every new stack starts it again (20 ticks is a second).
config.jojoha.stagger_ticks.tooltip: Ticks of Stun I that Uppercut, Star Finger, Ground Breaker, Tendril Spike, Thunder Cross Split Attack and a Stand user's barrage leave behind (20 ticks is a second).
config.jojoha.syo_lock_ticks.tooltip: Ticks of Stun II the last blow of Sunlight Yellow Overdrive leaves (20 ticks is a second). Players are never stunned past 1.5 seconds.
config.jojoha.stun_repeat.tooltip: How much of a stun a mob still takes when it was stunned only a moment ago, so it cannot be stun-locked.
config.jojoha.stun_repeat_window.tooltip: Ticks after a mob's stun ends during which a new stun is shortened (20 ticks is a second).
config.jojoha.boss_status.tooltip: How much of any of this mod's statuses bosses (the Wither, the Warden, the Ender Dragon and the Elder Guardian) take.
config.jojoha.mob_statuses.tooltip: Whether vampires' bites make you bleed (no deeper than Bleeding III, except from Rippers) and a Stand user's barrage ends in Stun I.
config.jojoha.vaporous_freeze_ticks.tool: Ticks Vaporous Freeze leaves its targets frozen, taking vanilla freezing damage (20 ticks is a second). 0 turns the freezing off.
config.jojoha.scythe_damage.tooltip: Damage the Meteorite Scythe's right-click sweep deals to everything around you.
config.jojoha.scythe_radius.tooltip: How far around you the Meteorite Scythe's sweep reaches.
config.jojoha.scythe_cooldown.tooltip: Ticks before the Meteorite Scythe can sweep again (20 ticks is a second).
config.jojoha.star_mirror.tooltip: How many ticks (a tick is 0.05 seconds) the Star Mirror adds to every parry window.
config.jojoha.last_stand.tooltip: Automatic defences (Enhanced Reflexes, Combat Adaptation's auto-parry) only act at or below this much of your health, and only against hostile mobs, never players or their pets. 100 lets them act at any health.
config.jojoha.parry_lag_allowance.toolti: Most ticks a parry may reach back for a blow that landed just before it, scaled to each player's ping. Keeps the 0.1 second parry fair online. 0 turns it off.
config.jojoha.shoulder_plate.tooltip: How much less energy a summoned Stand drains while the Fractured Shoulder Plate is worn.
config.jojoha.defense_skill_cost.tooltip: How much more energy Stand skills cost in Defense mode, while the Stand's attention is on guarding you.
config.jojoha.defense_punch_slow.tooltip: How much longer the wait between your Stand's punches is in Defense mode.
config.jojoha.half_summon_recovery.toolt: Seconds for a half-summoned Stand to refill from empty while it guards. 0 turns the refill off.
config.jojoha.time_stopper_moves.tooltip: How long someone who can stop time keeps moving inside another player's stopped time before they freeze too, in ticks (20 = one second).
config.jojoha.stand_drain_combat.tooltip: Seconds a summoned Stand takes to drain a full bar just by being out during a fight, before move costs.
config.jojoha.stand_drain_idle.tooltip: Seconds a summoned Stand takes to drain a full bar just by being out when no fight is on.
config.jojoha.skull_of_fortune.tooltip: How strongly the Skull of Fortune amplifies its wearer's Fortune, its gifts and its drawbacks alike.
config.jojoha.stand_placement_range.tool: How far players may move their resting Stand from its usual spot, on each axis. 0 locks every Stand to its usual spot.
config.jojoha.custom_idles.tooltip: Whether players may give their Stand an idle animation imported from Blockbench. Other players see it too.
config.jojoha.chips_any_armor.tooltip: Whether a Soul Chip can dress any armor piece at the smithing table, not only the usual armor sets.
config.jojoha.player_awakening.tooltip: Multiplies a player's chance that a Stand Arrow or shard awakens a Stand. Worthiness still decides the base odds.
config.jojoha.mob_awakening.tooltip: Multiplies the chance that a mob struck by a Stand Arrow or shard awakens a Stand.
config.jojoha.legendary_trait.tooltip: The chance that a newly rolled trait is legendary, before luck.
config.jojoha.birthmark.tooltip: Now and then, the chance that a worthy player without a Stand, standing near a Stand user with the Joestar Birthmark trait, awakens one of their own.
config.jojoha.second_hand.tooltip: The chance that a melee attack from a player with the Two Right Hands trait strikes again with the other right hand.
config.jojoha.spirit_lean.tooltip: How strongly the way you play leans which Stand an arrow gives you. 0 makes every Stand equally likely.
config.jojoha.stand_spread.tooltip: How much less likely an arrow is to give a Stand that more players on this world already hold. 0 ignores who holds what.
config.jojoha.hermit_mastery.tooltip: How many full bars of Hamon a Stand-less Hamon user must spend before Hermit Purple awakens in them. 0 turns this off.
config.jojoha.fortunes.tooltip: Whether players roll a Fortune (Wicked, Lucky, Bizarre, Honorbound, Cursed or Idealogue) and feel its effects.
config.jojoha.limb_loss.tooltip: Whether heavy blows in a fight, slicing attacks and Bleeding IV running out can cost a player a limb. Falls and explosions never do, and a player who just lost a limb is safe for a minute.
config.jojoha.wicked_tremble.tooltip: How long a hostile mob near a Wicked player trembles, slowed, in ticks (20 = one second).
config.jojoha.wicked_radius.tooltip: How close a hostile mob must come to a Wicked player to start Trembling. Each mob trembles at most once every 30 seconds. 0 turns this off.
config.jojoha.loot_stand_arrows.tooltip: Multiplies how often Stand Arrows, shards and skin arrows turn up in vanilla structure chests: dungeons, temples, mansions, strongholds, fortresses, bastions, ancient cities and End cities.
config.jojoha.loot_arrowheads.tooltip: Multiplies how often Ancient Arrowheads turn up in chests.
config.jojoha.loot_requiem_arrow.tooltip: Multiplies how often the Requiem Arrow turns up in the rarest chests.
config.jojoha.loot_stone_masks.tooltip: Multiplies how often Stone Masks turn up in chests.
config.jojoha.loot_path_scrolls.tooltip: Multiplies how often Hamon path books turn up in chests.
config.jojoha.loot_fishing_arrows.toolti: Multiplies the small chance of reeling in a Stand Arrow.
config.jojoha.stand_damage.tooltip: Multiplies the damage of every Stand punch, barrage, grab and Stand move used by players.
config.jojoha.hamon_damage.tooltip: Multiplies the damage of Hamon moves and Hamon-charged punches.
config.jojoha.vampire_damage.tooltip: Multiplies the damage of a vampire player's moves, bite and drive.
config.jojoha.combat_damage.tooltip: Multiplies parry counters, the rapier thrust and bleeding.
config.jojoha.mob_stand_damage.tooltip: Multiplies the damage mobs deal with their Stands, including Anubis swordsmen.
config.jojoha.vampire_mob_damage.tooltip: Multiplies the damage of vampire mobs' special attacks.
config.jojoha.player_damage.tooltip: An extra multiplier on all of the above when the one being hit is a player. Lower it to soften PvP without touching fights with mobs.
config.jojoha.max_per_hit.tooltip: No single hit from the mod can deal more than this, after every multiplier. 0 means no cap.
config.jojoha.stand_damage_for.tooltip: Multiplies %s's damage, on top of Stand Attacks or Mob Stands.

passive.jojoha.enhanced_reflexes.desc: At 40% health or less, deflects one blow a mob throws from within 4 blocks. Recovers over 3.5 seconds, down to 1.5 seconds at high Protection.
passive.jojoha.unwavering.desc: 50% knockback resistance, rising to 90% below half health. Blows no longer interrupt you.
passive.jojoha.two_meters.desc: Your Stand's next blow deals 1.3x within 2 blocks, fading to normal by 9. Recharges over 4 seconds.
passive.jojoha.sensory_perception.desc: Marks containers within 12 blocks through walls and floors.
passive.jojoha.grappling_vine_ii.desc: 24% faster on foot instead of 12%, and 80% of fall damage ignored instead of 45%.
passive.jojoha.thornbind.desc: The vine leaves its thorns in. What it strikes bleeds for 5 seconds.
passive.jojoha.ripple_conduction.desc: With Hamon, the vine conducts. Thorn Whip and Twisting Gut Punch deal 6 more to the undead.
passive.jojoha.second_sight.desc: Clairvoyance lasts 1.75x as long and comes back 25% sooner.
archetype.jojoha.brawler.desc: Close range. Built for combos and melee pressure.
archetype.jojoha.heaven.desc: Close range. A boss among Stands that grows stronger the longer a fight lasts.
archetype.jojoha.ranged.desc: Long range. Built for zoning, projectiles, and keeping the fight at a distance.
archetype.jojoha.control.desc: Changes the ground a fight is fought on rather than the fighter.
archetype.jojoha.specialist.desc: Its own rules. Information, dimension, and mechanics the other three do not have.
skills.jojoha.player.desc: Moves that need no Stand and no Hamon. Any body can learn them.
skills.jojoha.hamon.desc: Breathing techniques. Cost Hamon energy, and which you can learn depends on your path.
skills.jojoha.vampire.desc: What the mask makes possible. Costs blood and energy. Sunlight is fatal.
skills.jojoha.stand.desc: Everything your Stand can do. Needs it manifested and costs its energy.
move.jojoha.ripple_pulse.desc: Hamon out in every direction. 4.5 damage to everything within 3.5 blocks, thrown away from you. Costs 20. 2s cooldown.
move.jojoha.ripple_pulse.short: A burst of Hamon that throws back everything around you.

message.jojoha.stand_arrow.shot: An arrow found you, and something in you answered it.
message.jojoha.mask.raise: The stone is cold in your hands.
message.jojoha.mask.seated: It fits. It was always going to fit.
message.jojoha.mask.become: You are not what you were.
message.jojoha.mask.daylight: The stone is inert. It sleeps while the sun is up.
message.jojoha.mask.unfed: The stone is dry. It has tasted nothing.
message.jojoha.mask.aja_unworthy: The Red Stone waits for a Pillar Man.
message.jojoha.mask.fed: The blood soaks in. The stone drinks it.

message.jojoha.skin_arrow.no_skins: Your Stand has only one form.
item.jojoha.stand_disc.whole_stand: Holds the whole Stand - play it to take it back.

message.jojoha.memory_disc.default_skin: Your Stand is wearing its own skin, which you already remember.
message.jojoha.stand_disc.restored_commi: Your Stand returns to you. %s is committed to memory.

menu.jojoha.workshop.rest.no_ready: This Stand has no battle stance to rest in.

menu.jojoha.workshop.summon.menacing.hin: A dark silhouette fades in slowly as menacing letters rise.

menu.jojoha.workshop.shout.over_heaven.l: Earn The World Over Heaven skin to learn this shout.
menu.jojoha.workshop.shout.duel.hint: Star Platinum's and The World's cries, taking turns.
menu.jojoha.workshop.shout.silent.hint: No cry and no floating words.

menu.jojoha.workshop.looks.wear.other: Saved for another Stand. Its stance and style still apply; the skin does not.

buildmode.jojoha.single.desc: Your Stand places 1 block where you aim, from your inventory.
buildmode.jojoha.row.desc: Hold use and aim to lay a straight row along the ground, from your inventory.
buildmode.jojoha.column.desc: Hold use and aim to raise a straight column, from your inventory.
buildmode.jojoha.free.desc: Hold use and aim to lay a line of blocks wherever you drag, from your inventory.
buildmode.jojoha.selection.desc: Click two corners and your Stand fills everything between them, up to 128 blocks. Sneak-click to drop a corner.
message.jojoha.magician.no_area: You must be inside your own area.
skill.jojoha.controlled_blaze.desc: Magician's Red flies to where you look, up to 14 blocks away, and wraps a ring of fire 4.5 blocks wide around the spot for 12 seconds. Enemies touching the wall take 2 damage every half second and start Burning. Inside the ring is your area. 20s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.controlled_blaze.short: Wraps a ring of fire around the spot you look at.
skill.jojoha.sweep_kick.desc: Magician's Red darts ahead and sweeps its leg through everything within 3 blocks: 5 damage, a stagger and a small launch. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.sweep_kick.short: Magician's Red sweeps the legs of everything near it.
skill.jojoha.crossfire_hurricane.desc: Magician's Red breathes a flaming ankh that flies where you look: 6 damage and Burning to the first enemy hit. 8s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.crossfire_hurricane_special: Magician's Red breathes 5 flaming ankhs one after another, each dealing 3.5 damage and Burning. 18s cooldown.
Fires a barrage of 5 flaming ankhs.
skill.jojoha.finger_snap.desc: Snap your fingers: every Magician's Flame within 32 blocks goes out at once, and your burning areas, walls and Inferno end. 2s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.finger_snap.short: Snaps out all your fire at once.
config.jojoha.magician_flames.tooltip: Whether Magician's Red's fire moves leave flames that spread a few blocks and burn out. They never destroy blocks, and Finger Snap puts them out.
skill.jojoha.red_bind.desc: Ropes of flame tie the enemy you look at, up to 10 blocks away: held in place for 2 seconds and set Burning. 14s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.red_bind.short: Ties an enemy in place with ropes of flame.
skill.jojoha.inferno.desc: Only inside your own area. For 12 seconds Magician's Red hits 25% harder and every hit sets Burning. 30s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.inferno.short: Inside your area, hit harder and set Burning for a short time.
skill.jojoha.life_sense.desc: Magician's Red raises a cross of flame pointing six ways. For 6 seconds you see every living thing within 24 blocks through walls. 15s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.life_sense.short: A heat radar that shows living things through walls.
skill.jojoha.containment.desc: For 1.5 seconds a wall of fire rises along the ground where you look, up to 12 blocks away. Turn your view to bend it; it can run 16 blocks. It stands for 10 seconds, and enemies touching it take 2 damage every half second, gain Burning and are pushed back. One wall at a time. 16s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.containment.short: Draws a wall of fire that follows where you look.
skill.jojoha.increase_temperature.desc: Heats up to 48 blocks within 4 blocks of Magician's Red into their burnt or smelted form: grass to dirt, sand to glass, cobblestone to stone, ice to water. 10s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.increase_temperature.short: Burns or smelts the blocks around Magician's Red.
skill.jojoha.infinite_inferno_fire.desc: Raises a dome of fire and ash 9 blocks around you for 2 minutes 30 seconds. Enemies inside are slowed and gain a stack of Burning every 2 seconds. The dome is your area. 5 minute cooldown.
skill.jojoha.infinite_inferno_fire.short: A dome of fire and ash that burns the enemies inside it.
passive.jojoha.territorial.desc: Inside an area made by your Stand, its attacks deal 15% more damage and you move faster.
passive.jojoha.territorial.short: Stronger and faster inside your own area.
passive.jojoha.encroachment.desc: While you stand inside your area it grows 0.1 blocks a second, up to 50% larger.
passive.jojoha.encroachment.short: Your area slowly grows while you stay in it.
passive.jojoha.flame_immunity.desc: Magician's Red's flames never hurt you, and inside your own area you cannot burn.
passive.jojoha.flame_immunity.short: Your own flames do not burn you.
passive.jojoha.burning_pressure.desc: Magician's Red's attacks have a 30% chance to stagger an enemy that is Burning.
passive.jojoha.burning_pressure.short: Burning enemies are easier to stagger.
item.jojoha.anubis.sealed: A Stand sealed in a blade.
item.jojoha.anubis.take: Right click to bind it as your Discipline. It works alongside any Stand, but not alongside Hamon.
message.jojoha.anubis.bonded: Anubis is bound to you. Any sword you hold is now Anubis.
message.jojoha.anubis.already: Anubis is already bound to you.
message.jojoha.anubis.released: Anubis lets go. You are yourself again.
message.jojoha.anubis.hamon: Your Hamon won't let Anubis bind to you. Your Discipline is Hamon or Anubis, not both.
message.jojoha.anubis.hamon_parts: Hamon and Anubis can't share one Discipline. Anubis leaves your hand.
message.jojoha.anubis.let_go_ask: Crouch and right click again to let Anubis go.
skill.jojoha.draw.desc: Right click with a blade: lunge and cut for 4-7. Parries as it comes out; a parried Draw counters for 6. 1.5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.draw.short: Lunge and cut with your blade, parrying as it comes out.
passive.jojoha.swordsmanship.desc: Blade: 25% faster swings, +0.5 reach, +10% damage, cuts through walls. A parry leaves that foe taking +15% for 5s.
passive.jojoha.combat_adaptation.desc: Learns each attack it meets: less damage, longer parries, then counters, then auto-parries mobs every 5s at 40% health or less. Fades out of sight.
message.jojoha.anubis.summon: Anubis is the blade in your hand. Hold a sword to draw it.
message.jojoha.anubis.no_blade: Anubis needs a blade in hand.
skill.jojoha.hermit_grapple.desc: Throws a vine that bites into stone and holds you. Jump to climb, sneak to pay out slack, press again to let go.
skill.jojoha.hermit_grapple.short: Throws a vine that anchors in stone and holds you.
skill.jojoha.thorn_zip.desc: Fires a vine from each arm at one anchor and hauls you to it. Ends on arrival. 1.3s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.thorn_zip.short: Vines from both arms haul you to one anchor.
skill.jojoha.lasso_of_thorns.desc: Loops a vine around anything living within 12 blocks and leads it. Press again to let go. 1s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.lasso_of_thorns.short: Loops a vine round a creature and leads it.
item.jojoha.head_jar.desc: Can hold a severed vampire head.
message.jojoha.vampire.severed: Your body is gone, but your head lives on. Bite something weak to take its body.
message.jojoha.vampire.headless: You have no body to do that with.
skill.jojoha.camera_crush.desc: Crushes a placed camera and reads a map from what develops. Reaches 8 blocks. Costs the camera. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.camera_crush.short: Crushes a placed camera and develops a map from it.
message.jojoha.skill.staggered: Staggered - only a guard or a way out.
passive.jojoha.grappling_vine.desc: 12% faster on foot, harder to knock out of the air, and 45% of fall damage ignored.
passive.jojoha.tangled.desc: Your strikes have an 18% chance to leave thorns in. Blocks 3 of the target's moves for 2.5 seconds.
passive.jojoha.made_for_this.desc: Harmful effects wear off 1 second faster every 3 seconds, down to a floor of 2 seconds.
passive.jojoha.unorthodox_method.desc: This Stand grows by being used. 1 point every 5 seconds it is out, rather than by killing with it.
skill.jojoha.thorn_whip.desc: Snaps the vine out to 13 blocks for 4.2 damage and flings the target away. Replaces Lasso of Thorns. 2.25s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.thorn_whip.short: Snaps the vine out and flings the target away.
skill.jojoha.twisting_gut_punch.desc: Hauls one target from up to 11 blocks in and punches it for 6 damage. Winded for 2.25 seconds. 3.5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.twisting_gut_punch.short: Hauls a distant target in and punches the wind out of it.
item.jojoha.meteorite_tablet.base_slot: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
keyword.jojoha.stun.1: Slowed, hitting half as hard, and only moves that answer a blow still work. Players are never held past %s seconds.
keyword.jojoha.stun.2: Held in place with no moves at all. Players are never held past %s seconds.
keyword.jojoha.bleed: Each new wound deepens it, up to three times. When it runs out it lands at once for %s, %s or %s damage. At its deepest it can cost a limb. Milk, Herbal Tea, healing and Hamon breathing ease it.
keyword.jojoha.burning: Stacks up to three times, burning %s, %s or %s a second for %s seconds. Water and Fire Resistance put it out.
keyword.jojoha.guard_break: Can't guard, parry or raise a shield until it wears off.
stat.jojoha.strength.how: §6Hit things yourself§f and §6mine hard blocks§f. Taking hits teaches more than safe fights.
stat.jojoha.vitality.how: §6Take hits and live§f. A blow worth §6half your hearts§f teaches most.
stat.jojoha.agility.how: §6Sprint§f. Ground covered §6on foot§f only. Boats and horses do not count.
stat.jojoha.endurance.how: §6Push on when it costs§f: §6sprint§f, §6swim§f, or run §6low on food or blood§f.
stat.jojoha.worthiness.how: §6Kill hostiles§f, §6explore new ground§f, §6find rare things§f. Bigger fights count more.
stat.jojoha.stand.power.how: §6Attack with your Stand§f rather than your fists. Every point of damage it deals counts.
stat.jojoha.stand.speed.how: §6Throw abilities§f. Every skill your Stand uses counts, whichever one it is.
stat.jojoha.stand.endurance.how: §6Keep your Stand summoned§f. Every second it holds form counts.
stat.jojoha.stand.protection.how: §6Block with your Stand§f. Every hit the guard turns aside counts.
stat.jojoha.stand.potential.how: §6Spend Stand energy§f. The costlier the ability, the more it widens the pool.
message.jojoha.perk.last_stand: Last Stand! You refuse to fall.
perk.jojoha.shieldbreaker.desc: Heavy Punch breaks a raised shield or guard.
perk.jojoha.staggering_blow.desc: Heavy Punch staggers what it hits for a moment.
perk.jojoha.recovery.desc: Heal half a heart every 4 seconds when fed and left alone for 10.
perk.jojoha.last_stand.desc: Survive a killing blow on 1 heart, once every 10 minutes.
perk.jojoha.undying.desc: Last Stand every 5 minutes, with 3 hearts left.
perk.jojoha.quick_recovery.desc: Dodge and Double Jump recover 20% faster.
perk.jojoha.slip_away.desc: Nothing can touch you for a moment after a Dodge.
perk.jojoha.wind_step.desc: Step up full blocks without jumping.
perk.jojoha.deep_lungs.desc: Hold your breath twice as long.
perk.jojoha.braced.desc: Your Stand's guard spends 20% less energy per blow.
perk.jojoha.immovable.desc: Guard takes a 50% heavier blow to shatter.
trait.jojoha.two_right_hands.desc: Melee attacks have a 20% chance to strike again with your other right hand, for half damage, briefly interrupting the target. Three of those within 5 seconds make your next attack a Double Blow: 125% damage and a knockback.
trait.jojoha.running_style.desc: You gather speed the longer you sprint, up to 18% over five seconds.
trait.jojoha.killers_luck.desc: Your killing prowess shifts each day. On a good one you hit harder and luck runs with you; on a bad one, nothing.
trait.jojoha.joestar_birthmark.desc: With a Stand of your own, a worthy player who stays near you may wake one of theirs.
trait.jojoha.devils_blessing.desc: You deal more damage to players of high Worthiness.
message.jojoha.trait.birthmark: Something answers. You were not alone when it did.
message.jojoha.dream.no_stand: There is nothing there to take or to feed. Ask me for something you have.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.trinket: Then take something bright, and do not ask me where it was.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.fate: I have shaken the jar. What settles is yours.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.self: You are a little more than you were.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.stand: It is a little more than it was. It will notice before you do.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.hollow: It is out. The arrow will answer you again, if it feels like it.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.align: It is leaning. The next arrow that finds you will remember what you asked.
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.align: Last time you asked me to lean the arrow. Has it found you yet?
message.jojoha.dream.ask.align: Which one? Name it, and I will tell you what it costs.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.align: %s. I can lean the arrow toward it. I cannot hand it to you. The more you give, the harder it leans.
message.jojoha.dream.align.odds.0: Half the time, it will be what you named.
message.jojoha.dream.align.odds.2: Nearly always. Not always. I do not promise.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.fortune: Another fortune. I will turn yours over, and you will live with what is underneath.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.fortune: It is turned. Do not ask me to turn it back.
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.fortun: Last time you asked for another fortune. Does it suit you?
message.jojoha.dream.meet.0: You are asleep. This is the other side of it.
message.jojoha.dream.meet.1: Everyone who sleeps passes under me. Almost nobody looks up.
message.jojoha.dream.meet.2: I keep nothing, and I want everything. Tell me what you want, and I will tell you what it costs.
message.jojoha.dream.again.long: It has been a long time. I did not forget you.
message.jojoha.dream.visits: That is %s times you have come to me. Most never come back at all.
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.trinke: Last time you wanted something bright. Was it?
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.fate: Last time you asked for another trait. Is this one kinder?
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.self: Last time you asked to be more than you were. Did it help?
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.stand: Last time you asked me to feed your Stand. Has it thanked you?
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.hollow: Last time you gave me your Stand. I still have the shape of it.
message.jojoha.dream.last.offering: You paid me in %s. I remember the weight.
message.jojoha.dream.last.woke: Last time you left with your hands full.
message.jojoha.dream.last.ignored: Last time you stood here and said nothing. I waited.
message.jojoha.dream.stand.outside: %s waited at the door. It cannot come in here.
message.jojoha.dream.stand.new: There is something new in you. %s. I can smell it on you.
message.jojoha.dream.stand.gone: You are quieter than you were. Your Stand is gone.
message.jojoha.dream.reply.fate: A different trait than the one I drew.
message.jojoha.dream.hint: Look at a light and touch it [%s]
message.jojoha.dream.lore.0: I was somebody once, awake, like you. I do not remember who. It does not matter now.
message.jojoha.dream.lore.1: I was here before arrows. Before masks. I was here when the first of you dreamed.
message.jojoha.dream.lore.2: I do not give. I trade. A gift is only a debt you have not found yet.
message.jojoha.dream.lore.3: You want to know if I am kind. I am exact. It is better.
message.jojoha.dream.lore.done: You have asked me that before. The answer has not changed.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.trinket: Something bright. Never less than you gave - and the more you give, the kinder the jar.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.fate: Another trait. I will shake the jar, and what settles is yours. The more you give, the likelier a rare one.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.self: More of you. %s, then. One step for every diamond's worth you give, up to four.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.stand: More of %s. %s, then. One step for every diamond's worth you give, up to four.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.hollow: You want %s out of you. It will not come back.
message.jojoha.dream.price: %s would do, or anything worth as much. Let it fall from your hand, a piece at a time if you like.
message.jojoha.dream.price.least: %s at the least, or anything worth as much. More, and it goes better for you.
message.jojoha.dream.price.any: Anything you would miss will do. A little buys a little; something dear buys a great deal.
message.jojoha.dream.enough: That would do. Give me more and I will give you more - or touch the light, and I will take what I have.
message.jojoha.dream.remind: Let it fall from your hand. I will take it up, and keep count.
message.jojoha.dream.dust: That is dust. Bring me dust you would grieve for.
message.jojoha.dream.not_enough: Not yet. %s more would do, or anything worth as much.
message.jojoha.dream.taken.same: %s again. You know what I like.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.player.0: Your arms. You lean on them too much to leave them weak.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.player.1: Your blood. It runs a little hotter now.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.player.2: Your feet. You will be somewhere else before the blow lands.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.player.3: Your breath. It will last a little longer when it matters.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.player.4: Your heart. Arrows will look at you differently.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.stand.0: Its fists. They will land heavier.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.stand.1: Its hands. Faster than your eyes, now, by a little.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.stand.2: Its breath, which is yours. The two of you will last longer.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.stand.3: Its skin. Harder to wound than it was.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.stand.4: What it could become. You will not see that yet.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.amount.0: Only a breath of it - not a whole step. It will grow into the rest.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.amount.3: A great deal. You paid for it.
message.jojoha.dream.boost.amount.4: More than anyone has asked of me in a long time. Do not waste it.
message.jojoha.dream.gamble.robbed: Ha! Oh, that is cruel. You gave me a fortune and I gave you a handful. You lost, little one.
message.jojoha.dream.gamble.lost: Less than you gave. The jar keeps its share - you lost that one. That is what a gamble is.
message.jojoha.dream.gamble.even: Exactly what you gave. Nothing won, nothing lost. How dull.
message.jojoha.dream.gamble.won: More than you gave. The jar likes you, tonight.
message.jojoha.dream.gamble.jackpot: Oh! Look at that - twice what you gave, and more. Do not get used to it.
message.jojoha.dream.fate.rare: Oh. Oh, that is a rare one. I have not seen that settle in a long time.
message.jojoha.dream.fate.settled: It has settled. You are %s now.
message.jojoha.dream.perk: And something opened, on the way up: %s.
message.jojoha.dream.trust: It trusts you more than it did. %s.
message.jojoha.dream.rank: The two of you are closer. %s.
message.jojoha.dream.part.granted: Now wake. The night is still yours.
message.jojoha.dream.part.woke: Then sleep on. I will be here.
message.jojoha.dream.part.impatient: Then keep it all. Wake where you left off.
message.jojoha.dream.price.memory: Or let me take your memories instead. Touch that light.
message.jojoha.dream.memory.taken: Mm. You will hardly miss those.
message.jojoha.dream.memory.thin: There is too little left in you to take.
message.jojoha.dream.taken.memories: Your memories. Yes. They taste of you.
message.jojoha.dream.wants.forget: You want it out of you. Every breath, every lesson. It will be as if you never learned.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.forget: It is gone. You will reach for it, sometimes, and find nothing.
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.forget: Last time you asked me to make you forget. Do you feel lighter?
message.jojoha.dream.wants.night: Another night. I will give you a lily. Eat it, and sleep will bring you back to me.
message.jojoha.dream.granted.night: Here. Do not let it wilt.
message.jojoha.dream.last.granted.night: You came back the way I showed you.
perk.jojoha.fated.desc: +5% odds with Stand Arrows and shards.
perk.jojoha.recognised.desc: An arrow that turns you away wounds you far less.
perk.jojoha.chosen.desc: The Requiem Arrow answers you once your Stand reaches Bond Rank II.
perk.jojoha.heavens_favour.desc: Once a day, an arrow that fails you is not used up.
perk.jojoha.guard_crusher.desc: A Stand blow breaks a raised shield or guard, once every 5 seconds.
perk.jojoha.finisher.desc: Stand blows deal 20% more to foes under a fifth of their health.
perk.jojoha.swift_step.desc: Stand Dash, Stand Leap and Time Skip recover 20% faster.
perk.jojoha.time_is_short.desc: Every fifth Stand move recovers twice as fast.
perk.jojoha.steady_form.desc: Your Stand refills 15% faster once away, out of a fight.
perk.jojoha.unwavering_form.desc: Keeping your Stand out drains 15% less.
perk.jojoha.unbreakable_form.desc: Keeping your Stand out never drains the last 10% of its energy.
perk.jojoha.rebuke.desc: Parrying with your Stand restores 50% more energy.
perk.jojoha.bulwark.desc: A broken Stand guard comes back 25% sooner.
perk.jojoha.boundless.desc: Stand blows restore 50% more Stand energy.
item.jojoha.stand_arrow.unworthy: Needs Worthiness %s (you have %s). It will wound you.
message.jojoha.stand_arrow.unworthy: You are not worthy. The arrow needs Worthiness %s.
message.jojoha.stand_arrow.rejected_reco: Nothing answers. The arrow knows you, and cuts shallow.
message.jojoha.stand_arrow.rejected_kept: Nothing answers. The arrow stays in your hand.
item.jojoha.requiem_arrow.part5: Requiem is coming in the Part 5 update.
item.jojoha.requiem_arrow.needs_bonded: A Stand at Bond Rank II
message.jojoha.requiem_arrow.no_stand: The arrow has nothing to answer to. You need a Stand.
message.jojoha.requiem_arrow.not_bonded: Your Stand does not trust you enough yet. The arrow needs Bond Rank II.
message.jojoha.requiem_arrow.not_chosen: You are not chosen. The arrow needs Worthiness %s.
message.jojoha.requiem_arrow.answers: The arrow answers you... and waits.
message.jojoha.bond_rank.rose: Your bond with your Stand deepens - %s
trust.jojoha.tooltip.title: Trust - %s
trust.jojoha.tooltip.how: Trust grows with your Stand: it is the average of its five stats (now %s).
trust.jojoha.tooltip.energy: +%s Stand energy from your Bond Rank.
dream.jojoha.wish.trinket.desc: Gifts drawn from what the world calls treasure, and from things only you would know. Give more for more, and better. Never worth less than you gave.
dream.jojoha.wish.fate.desc: Your trait is drawn again, never the one you carry. Give more for better odds of a rare one.
dream.jojoha.wish.self.desc: One of your own five, raised - you choose which. One point for every diamond's worth, up to four. Less than that buys experience.
dream.jojoha.wish.stand.desc: One of your Stand's five, raised - you choose which. One point for every diamond's worth, up to four. Less than that buys experience.
dream.jojoha.wish.hollow.desc: Your Stand is taken, with its tree and its bar. An arrow can answer you again afterwards.
dream.jojoha.wish.align.desc: Only without a Stand. Name one, and the next arrow that awakens you gives it half the time. Give more and it leans harder, up to nine times in ten.
dream.jojoha.wish.fortune.desc: Your Fortune is drawn again, never the one you carry.
dream.jojoha.wish.forget.desc: Your Discipline is taken, with its tree. Hamon and its paths, or the bond with Anubis.
dream.jojoha.wish.night.desc: A Lucid Lily. Eat it, and your next sleep brings you back to the dream.
item.jojoha.meteor_map.blank: The ink has not settled yet.
item.jojoha.stat_crystal.use: Use to move %s to %s levels from your highest stat into your lowest
message.jojoha.stat_crystal.full: Every stat is already at its peak
message.jojoha.stat_crystal.moved: The crystal moves %s levels from %s into %s.
item.jojoha.speedwagon_tonic.use: Drink to parry 1 tick longer for 3 minutes
item.jojoha.coffee_flavored_gum.use: Chew to refill Stand energy faster for 1 minute
item.jojoha.zeppeli_wine.use: Drink to recover breath faster for 2 minutes. It spills if you are hit
item.jojoha.blood_vial.use: Refills some blood for a vampire. Foul to anyone else
item.jojoha.lucid_lily.use: Eat, and your next sleep carries you into the Dream
message.jojoha.lucid_lily: Your eyelids grow heavy. Tonight, you will dream.
item.jojoha.cherries.use: Eat to ready your dodge and dash again at once
item.jojoha.tarot_card.use: Use to draw a card. Most are kind, a few are not
item.jojoha.lucky_coin.use: Flip it. Heads brings luck, tails brings bad luck
item.jojoha.power_gem.use: Use to raise your Strength by one level
item.jojoha.agility_gem.use: Use to raise your Agility by one level
item.jojoha.endurance_gem.use: Use to raise your Endurance by one level
item.jojoha.vitality_gem.use: Use to raise your Vitality by one level
item.jojoha.worthiness_gem.use: Use to raise your Worthiness by one level
item.jojoha.wild_gem.use: Use to raise a random stat by one level, sometimes two
item.jojoha.garlic.use: Eat to keep the undead away for 60 seconds. It sickens vampires
item.jojoha.darios_letter.use: Read it for a hint of where the Phantom Moors lie
item.jojoha.royal_crown.desc: +1 Luck, and villagers sell to you for less.
item.jojoha.heavy_ring.desc: Your stats grow 25% faster from training.
item.jojoha.cigarette.use: Light it with flint and steel or a fire charge in your other hand
item.jojoha.cigarette_lit.use: Blow a puff of smoke that hides you from mobs and nauseates anyone else inside it
item.jojoha.coca_cola.use: Drink for Speed for 30 seconds. Sneak to throw it, staggering what it hits
item.jojoha.zombie_horse.use: Heals, stops Bleeding and stitches a lost limb back on
item.jojoha.gyros_coffee.use: Haste for 60 seconds and a little food. Leaves the mug
item.jojoha.herbal_tea.use: Clears Poison, Nausea and Bleeding and gives brief Regeneration. Leaves the mug
item.jojoha.valentines_napkin.use: Bless the next chest you open: it fills twice
message.jojoha.mask.fake_aja: The Red Stone of Aja cracks. It was a fake!
message.jojoha.valentines_napkin.blessed: The next chest you open is blessed.
message.jojoha.cigarette.no_light: You need flint and steel or a fire charge in your other hand.
message.jojoha.darios_letter.read: A father's last letter to his son, stained with brandy.
message.jojoha.darios_letter.hint: It speaks of a fog-bound moor to the %s.
item.jojoha.torn_manga_page.use: Read to learn a little toward a random stat
item.jojoha.road_roller_key.use: There is no road roller, you can sell this to Willow.
config.jojoha.loot_curios.tooltip: Multiplies how often tonics, cherries, tarot cards and other small finds turn up in chests.
message.jojoha.meteor.incoming: The sky splits open above you.
skill.jojoha.clairvoyance.desc: Sees through stone 12 seconds: life within 48 blocks, ore and chests within 24. Only you see it. 30s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.clairvoyance.short: See life, ore and chests through stone for a while.
skill.jojoha.stand_fell.desc: Aim at a tree's log and your Stand chops the whole trunk, up to 32 logs, with the tool in your hand. Only trees with natural leaves, so log houses are safe. Utility stance. 5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.stand_carry.desc: Your Stand picks up the animal or villager you aim at and carries it in its arms. Left click to throw it, or use again to set it down. It lets go if you leave Utility stance. Hostile mobs can't be carried. Utility stance.
skill.jojoha.precise_eyes.desc: Star Platinum's eyes zoom in like a spyglass. While focused, blocks your Stand digs come out cleanly: torches, rails and carpet resting on them stay where they are. Use again to stop. Utility stance.
skill.jojoha.precise_eyes.short: Zoom in; dig without knocking off torches.
skill.jojoha.delivery.desc: The World throws the stack in your main hand to the player you aim at, or into the chest, barrel or other container you aim at. Whatever doesn't fit stays in your hand. Utility stance. 1s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.delivery.short: Send your held stack to a player or chest.
skill.jojoha.tendril_work.desc: Hierophant's tendril works the nearest lever, button, door or gate within 3 blocks of where you aim, even around corners and through gaps. Sneak to string an alarm net instead: it pings you when a hostile mob or another player crosses it. One net at a time, lasts 5 minutes. Utility stance.
skill.jojoha.tendril_work.short: Work switches around corners; sneak for an alarm net.
skill.jojoha.clearing.desc: Silver Chariot cuts grass, ferns, leaves, vines and cobwebs in an arc in front of you. Aim at a log close by to strip it instead. Utility stance. 1s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.clearing.short: Cut growth in an arc, or strip a log.
skill.jojoha.kiln.desc: Magician's Red cooks up to 16 dropped items where you aim, like a furnace, using its own flames instead of fuel. It also lights campfires and candles and melts snow and ice nearby. Utility stance. 5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.kiln.short: Cook dropped items; light candles; melt ice.
message.jojoha.chore.nothing_to_carry: Nothing your Stand can carry there.
message.jojoha.delivery.nobody: Aim at a player or a container.
message.jojoha.tendril_work.no_ground: Aim at the ground to string the net.
message.jojoha.kiln.nothing: Nothing to cook, light or melt there.
skill.jojoha.stand_fetch.desc: Your Stand gathers every dropped item within its reach and brings it to you. Utility stance. 2s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.stand_harvest.desc: Your Stand picks every grown crop within 5 blocks of where you aim and replants each one from its own seeds. The harvest comes to you. Utility stance. 3s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.stand_harvest.short: Pick grown crops and replant them.
skill.jojoha.stand_reach.desc: Your Stand works the switch you aim at from range: levers, buttons, doors, trapdoors, gates, bells, note blocks, repeaters and comparators. Utility stance.
skill.jojoha.stand_reach.short: Flip levers, buttons and doors from range.
message.jojoha.chore.nothing_to_reach: Nothing your Stand can work there.
skill.jojoha.dowsing.desc: Braided vines crawl along the ground toward the nearest ore within 32 blocks and dive in above it; the ore glows for you once they arrive. Hold an ore block to dowse for that ore only. Utility stance. 10s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.dowsing.short: Vines crawl toward the nearest ore.
tooltip.jojoha.weapon_class.sabre.1: Parry: right click times a parry
tooltip.jojoha.weapon_class.sabre.2: with any blade. After a perfect
tooltip.jojoha.weapon_class.sabre.3: parry, a sabre's next is perfect.

advancements.jojoha.part1.root.descripti: A stone mask, an English manor, and a very bad idea.
advancements.jojoha.part1.the_mask.title: A Stone from the Aztecs
advancements.jojoha.part1.the_mask.descr: Get hold of a Stone Mask.
advancements.jojoha.part1.the_change.des: Wear the mask and let it take you.
advancements.jojoha.part1.into_the_moors: Set foot in the Phantom Moors.
advancements.jojoha.part2.into_the_bonel: Set foot in the Skeleton Heel Bonelands.
advancements.jojoha.part3.into_the_sands: Set foot in the Stardust Sands.

advancements.jojoha.part1.bloodied_hands: Kill something with a dagger in hand.

advancements.jojoha.part2.root.descripti: Breathe in. The sun is a weapon.

advancements.jojoha.part3.root.title: Stardust Crusaders
advancements.jojoha.part3.root.descripti: Fifty days, half the world, and a Stand of your own.
advancements.jojoha.part3.the_arrow.desc: Find a whole Stand Arrow. Few ever do.
advancements.jojoha.part3.stand_proud.de: Survive the arrow and wake a Stand.
advancements.jojoha.part3.lets_cosplay.d: Dress up in a JoJo cosplay using Soul Chips on your armour.
advancements.jojoha.part3.star_metal.des: Mine raw meteorite from a fallen star.
advancements.jojoha.part3.refined.title: Beaten Into Shape
