message.jojoha.path_scroll.learned_first: You can now use Hamon. %s learned.
message.jojoha.path_scroll.undead: The words mean nothing to the dead.
message.jojoha.path_scroll.anubis: Anubis won't let you learn Hamon. Let the blade go first.
message.jojoha.hermit_mastery: Your breathing has worn a path through you. Something purple grows along it.
death.attack.jojoha.hamon_backlash: %1$s was torn apart by their own Hamon
fortune.jojoha.wicked.desc: Animals and villagers flee from you, and hostile mobs that come near you start Trembling, slowed for a moment. Other players feel the edges of their sight dim when you come near. Go a day without killing and your sight starts to shudder now and then, worse each day, until you kill again.
fortune.jojoha.lucky.desc: +1 Luck, slightly better Stand Arrow odds, and Equalizer Crystals roll twice and keep the better. Now and then you feel drawn toward a structure. Your phobia can break your luck for 30 seconds.
fortune.jojoha.bizarre.desc: Four mismatched armour pieces or a full JoJo set make you Charismatic: Luck and a little speed near other players, cheaper villager trades, and nearby players sense which way you are. You hear whispers of meteors, structures and Stand users, and chests you loot sometimes hold something extra.
fortune.jojoha.honorbound.desc: Fair fighting earns Honor and cowardice loses it. High Honor adds a point of melee damage, low Honor takes one away. A dominated opponent gets one second wind, what you give an opponent is mirrored back to you, and if you fall beside an ally they fight on stronger.
fortune.jojoha.cursed.desc: The world is out to get you, but your spirit outlasts it. You carry a vicious handicap, and no single blow can take your last half heart, though a blow at half a heart still kills. When you die you linger as a spirit to carry your items home or haunt your killer, without your Stand. You can trade your curse for another.
fortune.jojoha.idealogue.desc: Only through trial do we find strength. In a one-on-one fight you deal more damage to a bigger or Stand-using foe and take less when cornered. Winning a duel grants experience and a near-instant recovery. Two days without a fight and your luck and attack speed wither. Mobs born with a Stand come for you, and every 10 levels make you faster and quicker at mining out of combat.
fortune.jojoha.curse.blinded.desc: You are always blind. Lean on Scent or Hearing to find your way. Until you choose, anything making noise near you glows for you, even through walls.
fortune.jojoha.curse.fragile.desc: You take double damage, but your spirit lasts twice as long, is perfectly invisible and keeps your Stand out. It cannot pick up items, and passes on when its Stand falls.
fortune.jojoha.curse.legless.desc: You cannot stand or jump, and crawl along, climbing only slabs and stairs. Pain is slow to reach you: every blow lands two seconds late.
fortune.jojoha.phobia.tetraphobia.desc: A stack of exactly four, four of one kind of mob around you, or a fourth hit in a row breaks your luck.
fortune.jojoha.phobia.tetraphobia.short: Fours break your luck: stacks, mobs, or hits in a row.
fortune.jojoha.phobia.superstition.desc: The first blow from a Stand or the undead in a fight, or lightning nearby, breaks your luck and weakens you for a moment. It cannot happen again until you have gone a minute without one.
fortune.jojoha.phobia.superstition.short: A fight with a Stand or the undead opens by breaking your luck.
message.jojoha.curse.no_stand: A spirit cannot call its Stand.
message.jojoha.curse.stand_bound: Your spirit is bound to your Stand.
message.jojoha.idealogue.unsatiated: Days without a fight. You grow restless.
message.jojoha.fortune.phobia: Your luck comes with a fear: %s. %s
message.jojoha.fortune.bizarre_pull: You feel a pull to the %s.
message.jojoha.fortune.drawn: You feel drawn toward someone to the %s.
message.jojoha.fortune.sacrifice: %s fell in your place. Fight on.
message.jojoha.fortune.honor.backshot: Honor lost: a shot in the back
message.jojoha.fortune.honor.cowardice: Honor lost: you flinch from the fight
item.jojoha.bubble_gloves.desc: Caesar Zeppeli's gloves. Wear them to use Bubble Launcher and Bubble Cutter.
item.jojoha.lisa_scarf.desc: Made of Satiporoja beetle silk, which conducts Hamon. Wear it to use Snake Muffler.
item.jojoha.star_mirror.desc: All parry windows last a tick (0.05s) longer.
item.jojoha.creative_cube.desc: Utility mode no longer spends energy.
item.jojoha.skull_of_fortune.desc: Amplifies your Fortune, as well as strengthening its drawbacks.
item.jojoha.warding_charm.desc: Stand-possessed mobs no longer gather around you.
item.jojoha.josephs_fingerless_gloves.de: After a perfect parry, your next blow within a second deals 2 more damage.
item.jojoha.speedwagons_bowler_hat.desc: Speedwagon withdraws coolly: you sprint 15% faster below 30% health.
item.jojoha.caesars_headband.desc: Bubble Cutter fires two bubbles a shot, and all your bubbles fly 30% faster.
item.jojoha.polnareff_earring.desc: Afterimages splits Chariot into 2 more images.
item.jojoha.jotaros_cap.desc: Good grief: once your Stand guard takes 3 blows within 5 seconds, your next Stand punch staggers.
item.jojoha.sherrys_locket.desc: A landed Riposte readies Balestra at once.
item.jojoha.hamon_control_mask.burden: You cannot eat or drink while wearing it.
item.jojoha.ring_of_aja.desc: Hamon deals 20% more damage in sunlight.
item.jojoha.ring_of_aja.burden: Hamon deals 20% less at night or out of the sky.
item.jojoha.dios_headband.desc: Each mob killed in your stopped time takes 3 seconds off Time Stop's cooldown when time resumes, up to half of it.
item.jojoha.wamuus_headdress.desc: While you sprint, a wind shell turns back arrows and projectiles coming from behind.
item.jojoha.wedding_ring_of_death.desc: Every blow you land deals 15% more damage.
item.jojoha.wedding_ring_of_death.burden: The poison ring counts down: go 3 minutes without striking a hostile mob and it leaks Poison II for 5 seconds.
message.jojoha.control_mask: The mask is in the way.
item.jojoha.fractured_shoulder_plate.des: Keeping your Stand out drains 5% less energy.
move.jojoha.next_line.desc: For 5 seconds you read your opponent. The next move a nearby player uses, or the next hit anyone throws at you, is called out loud in chat. That foe's next blow on you within 2 seconds misses, and a player loses 10% of their energy. Costs 18. 20s cooldown.
move.jojoha.next_line.short: Call your opponent's next move: it misses and drains them.
message.jojoha.ultimate.no_food: Your body takes nothing from food now. Drain or kill to feed.
move.jojoha.scarlet_overdrive.desc: A burning Hamon punch 3.5 blocks ahead: 6 damage, 9 to the undead, and sets the target alight for 4 seconds. The undead catch Burning instead, which stacks up to three times. Costs 18. 6s cooldown.
move.jojoha.scarlet_overdrive.short: A burning Hamon punch that sets the target alight.
move.jojoha.thunder_cross_split_attack.d: Leap forward and chop down with crossed arms: 7 damage, 10 to the undead, to everything within 3 blocks in front of you. Costs 22. 8s cooldown.
move.jojoha.thunder_cross_split_attack.s: Leap in and chop down on everything in front of you.
move.jojoha.ripple_rebuke.desc: For 1 second, the first melee hit on you is stopped and its attacker takes 5 damage, 8 if undead, is thrown back and slowed. Costs 16. 6s cooldown.
move.jojoha.ripple_rebuke.short: Briefly stops the next melee hit and punishes its attacker.
move.jojoha.youthful_breath.desc: Breathe the years away: clears Slowness, Hunger, Weakness and Mining Fatigue, then Regeneration II for 5 seconds. Costs 20. 30s cooldown.
move.jojoha.youthful_breath.short: Breathes away your ailments, then mends you.
move.jojoha.bottle_cap_shot.desc: Needs a bottled drink in hand. Flicks a Hamon cap up to 24 blocks: 5 damage, 8 to the undead. Costs 10. 3s cooldown.
move.jojoha.bottle_cap_shot.short: Flicks a Hamon-charged bottle cap along your aim.
move.jojoha.zoom_punch.desc: Punches 10 blocks along your aim for 3.5 damage and drags the target in. Costs 12. 1.5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.zoom_punch.short: A stretching punch that drags the target in.
move.jojoha.clacker_volley.desc: Needs Clackers in hand. Hits one target 8 times with your clackers, 1.2 a blow. Costs 25. 6s cooldown.
move.jojoha.clacker_volley.short: Batters one target with a string of clacker blows.
move.jojoha.forced_ripple_breathing.desc: Hold to heal 1.5 a second within 4 blocks, clearing poison and wither. Costs 15, then 0.5 a tick.
move.jojoha.forced_ripple_breathing.shor: Hold to heal those around you and clear poison.
move.jojoha.bubble_cutter.desc: Hold to fire a stream of bubbles, one every 2 ticks. 0.8 damage each. Costs 8 to start and 2 a bubble. 1s cooldown.
move.jojoha.bubble_cutter.short: Hold to fire a steady stream of cutting bubbles.
move.jojoha.bubble_launcher.desc: Fans 40 bubbles ahead for 0.85 damage each, passing through what they hit. Costs 30. 8s cooldown.
move.jojoha.bubble_launcher.short: Fans a cloud of bubbles that pass through what they hit.
move.jojoha.snake_muffler.desc: Needs Lisa Lisa's Scarf on. Snakes out to hit a target within 7 blocks for 5.5 and drags it in. Costs 14. 3.5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.snake_muffler.short: Your scarf snakes out, strikes, and drags the target in.
move.jojoha.ripple_walk.desc: Hold to stand on water and climb walls at 0.2 blocks a tick. Sneak to go down. Costs 10 and drains 0.45 a tick.
move.jojoha.ripple_walk.short: Hold to stand on water and climb walls.
move.jojoha.turquoise_blue_overdrive.des: Needs water on or around you. 9 damage to everything wet within 6 blocks, 18 to the undead. Costs 25. 7s cooldown.
move.jojoha.turquoise_blue_overdrive.sho: Shocks everything wet around you. Needs water.
move.jojoha.hamon_overdrive.desc: Charges your hands 10 seconds. The next blow adds 4.5 damage, 9 against the undead. Costs 25. 6s cooldown.
move.jojoha.hamon_overdrive.short: Charges your hands so the next blow hits harder.
move.jojoha.ripple_barrier.desc: Hold to block every blow. Undead attackers take 5 back. Costs 30, draining while up. 15s cooldown.
move.jojoha.ripple_barrier.short: Hold to block every blow; the undead are burned for trying.
move.jojoha.channeling.desc: Charges your weapon 10 seconds. Blows on the undead add 2.5 damage, plus 2.5 per Conductivity. Costs 25. 20s cooldown.
move.jojoha.channeling.short: Charges your weapon to hurt the undead more.
message.jojoha.hamon.nothing_to_channel: Nothing in hand to run it through.
move.jojoha.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.de: 7 blows over 1 second within 4.5 blocks. 1.8 damage each, 4x that against the undead. Costs 60. 25s cooldown.
move.jojoha.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.sh: A rush of blows that devastates the undead.
message.jojoha.clackers.hum: Your clackers are charged with Hamon.
item.jojoha.clackers.desc: Multiplies Hamon damage by 1.25 while held.
item.jojoha.clackers.controls: Swing to throw them forward. Use to spin them around your hand and launch them outward.
message.jojoha.drain.dry: There is no blood in that.
message.jojoha.flesh_bud.not_yours: That bud is not yours to burst.
message.jojoha.flesh_bud.planted_on_you: Something is growing under your skin.
message.jojoha.vampire.too_young: Your body is not ready for that yet.
message.jojoha.hamon.no_clackers: You need a pair of Clackers in hand.
message.jojoha.hamon.no_bubble_gloves: You need Bubble Gloves on to use bubble Hamon.
message.jojoha.hamon.no_scarf: You need Lisa Lisa's Scarf on to use Snake Muffler.
message.jojoha.hamon.snake_muffler_no_ta: Nothing in reach for the scarf to strike.
message.jojoha.hamon.clacker_volley_no_t: Nothing in reach of your clackers.
message.jojoha.hamon.no_water: There is no water here to carry it.
message.jojoha.hamon.no_bottle: You need a bottle or bottled drink in hand to flick its cap.
message.jojoha.vampire.no_corpse: Nothing near you died recently enough to raise.
message.jojoha.vampire.nothing_to_fuse: You need two minions within %s blocks of you.
message.jojoha.half_summon.on: Ready stance: your Stand catches a blow every 5s and swats shots every 2s. Guarding refills energy. %s + summon again for the whole Stand.
message.jojoha.half_summon.piloting: Your Stand is fully out while you pilot it.
spec_passive.jojoha.ripple_breathing.des: Hamon refills 1.2 a second out of a fight, 3 seconds after the last blow. A charged blow adds 2.5, twice a second.
spec_passive.jojoha.hermit_bloom.desc: Hermit Path. Breathing quietly grows up to 3 plants within 4 blocks, doing what bone meal would do and costing nothing.
spec_passive.jojoha.held_breath.desc: Hermit Path. Air drains 3 times slower underwater. It still runs out, so you can go 3 times further and no further.
spec_passive.jojoha.undead_physiology.de: A dead body hits harder and moves faster. Vampire 2 and 10%, Pillar Man 4 and 18%, Ultimate 5.5 and 28%.
spec_passive.jojoha.blood_mending.desc: You heal half a heart every 3 seconds as a vampire, every 1.25 seconds at the last stage. Paid for in blood.
spec_passive.jojoha.unbroken_fall.desc: The first 4 hearts of any fall are ignored.
spec_passive.jojoha.sun_scorch.desc: Daylight sears you after 3 seconds and kills by 12. 2 damage, rising 1.6 a second. Shade cools you twice as fast.
spec_passive.jojoha.might.desc: Strength adds up to 2 attack damage, and multiplies a bare handed blow by 1.15 rising to 1.4.
spec_passive.jojoha.constitution.desc: Vitality adds up to 10 max health, which is 5 extra hearts at the cap.
spec_passive.jojoha.fleetness.desc: Agility adds up to 15% movement speed.
spec_passive.jojoha.hardiness.desc: Endurance adds up to 4 armour and up to 10% knockback resistance.
spec_passive.jojoha.resolve.desc: Worthiness adds up to 3 luck, and refills both energy bars up to 30% faster.
move.jojoha.heavy_punch.desc: One heavy blow within 3.5 blocks: 4.5 damage, 6 with your Stand out. Strong knockback. 3.5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.dodge.desc: A short hop the way you are already going. 2.25s cooldown.
move.jojoha.gut_punch.desc: 4 damage within 3.2 blocks, launching them and interrupting their swing. Costs 12. 2.75s cooldown.
move.jojoha.ground_slam.desc: Drives you down. On landing, 1.6 damage a block fallen up to 12, in a radius of 2 to 5.5 blocks. Costs 12. 3s cooldown.
move.jojoha.double_jump.desc: Passive: after jumping, tap jump again in mid air. Keeps all your speed. One a jump, back when you land.
move.jojoha.burst.desc: One hard shove exactly where you are looking. Flat, up or down. 3s cooldown.
move.jojoha.drain.desc: Bites one target within 4.5 blocks. 6 damage, 2 hearts healed and 5 blood. Costs 10. 3s cooldown.
move.jojoha.drain.short: Bites a target, healing you and filling your blood.
move.jojoha.vampiric_drive.desc: Charges for 6 seconds. The next blow that lands adds 8 damage and heavy knockback. Costs 25. 8s cooldown.
move.jojoha.vampiric_drive.short: Charges your next blow with extra force and knockback.
move.jojoha.flesh_bud.desc: Buds one target: it will not attack you, fights whatever you attack (or, if you have not attacked, whatever attacks you) and bursts after 60 seconds. A budded player is steered into the fight too. Costs 30. 10s cooldown.
move.jojoha.flesh_bud.short: Buds a target so it fights for you, then bursts.
move.jojoha.blitz.desc: Rushes 9 blocks forward, striking everything within 1.1 blocks of the line for 5 damage. Costs 18. 5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.blitz.short: Rushes forward, striking everything along the line.
move.jojoha.zombify.desc: Raises a body fallen within 8 blocks. 20 health, 4 damage, 3 minutes. 3 at once. Costs 30. 12s cooldown.
move.jojoha.zombify.short: Raises a nearby fallen body as your minion.
move.jojoha.amalgamate.desc: Pulls two minions within 12 blocks into your hands and fuses them. Amalgamation: 90 health, 7 damage. Abomination: 160 and 11. Costs 25. 15s cooldown.
move.jojoha.amalgamate.short: Fuses two of your minions into a stronger one.
move.jojoha.wall_crawl.desc: Hold to climb any wall at 0.22 blocks a tick. Sneak to go down. Costs 8 and drains 0.35 a tick.
move.jojoha.vaporous_freeze.desc: Needs Subzero. 8 damage within 3.5 blocks ahead, slows and freezes targets solid for 5 seconds, and freezes water. Costs 22. 4.5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.vaporous_freeze.short: Freezes what is in front of you solid. Needs Subzero.
move.jojoha.regeneration.desc: For 10 seconds a killing blow scatters you instead. You reform with 6 health, safe 2 seconds. Costs 25. 30s cooldown.
move.jojoha.regeneration.short: For a while, a killing blow scatters you instead.
move.jojoha.blood_boil.desc: Heat Mode. 9 damage in a cone 7 blocks ahead, setting them alight 6 seconds. Costs 35. 10s cooldown.
move.jojoha.blood_boil.short: Heat Mode. A cone of boiling blood that sets targets alight.
move.jojoha.subzero.desc: Hold to freeze your own blood, up to 7 seconds. Slows you and suspends your Hamon bonuses. Costs 35. 21s cooldown.
move.jojoha.subzero.short: Hold to freeze your own blood, at the cost of your speed.
move.jojoha.space_ripper_stingy_eyes.des: Fires a beam 32 blocks along your aim for 9 damage. The beam bends toward what it passes near. Costs 70. 15s cooldown.
move.jojoha.space_ripper_stingy_eyes.sho: A piercing beam that bends toward what it passes.
skill.jojoha.barrage.desc: A flurry of blows within 3.5 blocks. 5 hits over 0.75 seconds, dealing 1 damage each without a Stand. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.uppercut.desc: One rising blow within 4 blocks that launches the target upward. 6 damage with a Stand, 3 without. 2.5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.grab.desc: Grabs a target. Attack to throw it, sneak and attack to set it down. Carries players in stopped time. 2.5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.stand_dash.desc: A burst of speed in the direction you face. 2s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.stand_leap.desc: Leaps you forward and up. Catches whatever you meet within 1.5 seconds of landing. 3s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.recall_stand.desc: Calls the Stand back to you from wherever it is.
skill.jojoha.pilot.desc: Sends the Stand out 3 blocks to be steered directly. Your body stays where it is. 1s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.star_finger.desc: Extends a finger 10 blocks along your aim for 6 damage, driving the target back. 2.25s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.skull_crusher.desc: Crushes one target within 4.5 blocks for 6 damage and throws it. Stuns 3 seconds, 1.5 seconds on players. 7s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.ground_breaker.desc: Dives onto a marked spot 8 blocks ahead. A wave launches everything within 7.5 blocks for 6 damage. 8s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.knife_barrage.desc: Tap to fan 8 knives in a 70 degree arc for 2 damage each. Hold to send all 8 into one target. Sneak to throw them one by one, every 0.3 seconds, each straight at your target. In your own time stop, all 8 leave at once, hang in the air, and pierce through everything in their path when time moves again. 7s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.knife_barrage.short: Throws knives: tap to fan, hold to focus, sneak to chain.
skill.jojoha.emerald_splash_shotgun_blas: Fires 3 emerald shards at high pressure where you aim, 6 damage each. 5.5s cooldown.
Fires a tight blast of emerald shards where you aim.
skill.jojoha.emerald_splash_barrage.desc: Hold to gather, release a stream of shards that follows your aim. At 30% health, the Final Emerald Splash. 8s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.emerald_splash_barrage.shor: Hold to gather, release a stream of shards along your aim.
skill.jojoha.tendril_spike.desc: Two tentacles burst out of the ground, closing on your target from both sides. 6 damage and a toss. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.tendril_spike.short: Tentacles burst from the ground and toss your target.
skill.jojoha.web_swing.desc: Hold to throw a tentacle at a wall or roof and swing from it. Let go to fly.
skill.jojoha.web_swing.short: Hold to swing from a tentacle; let go to fly.
skill.jojoha.unravel_trap.desc: Unravels into a web on the floor where you look. Anything that steps in is entangled, 3 damage. Lasts 30s. 15s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.unravel_trap.short: Lays a web on the floor that entangles what steps in.
skill.jojoha.sword_flurry.desc: Chariot's Barrage. Hold for rapier thrusts: 50 per 7.5 seconds, quicker with the armour off. 18 to 24 in all. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.sword_flurry.short: Hold for a stream of rapier thrusts. Chariot's Barrage.
skill.jojoha.balestra.desc: Chariot lunges up to 6 blocks ahead. The first thing it runs through takes 6 damage, is held on the blade while Chariot twists it for 3 more, and is stunned for 1.25 seconds. 8s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.balestra.short: Chariot lunges, skewers the first thing hit and stuns it.
skill.jojoha.blade_launch.desc: Chariot shoots the blade off its rapier at what you look at, 6 damage. It fights bladeless until the blade lands. 12s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.blade_launch.short: Shoots the rapier's blade at what you look at.
skill.jojoha.sabre_cycle.desc: Hold to wind up, release for a slash all around you: 4 damage within 2.5 blocks, growing to 6 within 5 blocks at 2 seconds. 10s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.sabre_cycle.short: Hold to wind up, release to slash all around you.
skill.jojoha.deflection.desc: Hold for up to 3 seconds to deflect attacks from the front. Attackers are thrown back and projectiles fly back at the shooter. Each deflection costs energy. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.deflection.short: Hold to turn attacks and projectiles back from the front.
skill.jojoha.riposte.desc: Opens a 0.6 second counter. If you are struck in it, the blow misses and Chariot appears behind the attacker for a 6 damage slash and a stagger. 8s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.riposte.short: A brief counter: Chariot slips behind and slashes.
skill.jojoha.armor_release.desc: Chariot bursts out of its armour: you move and swing 20% faster and its flurry quickens, but you take 25% more damage. Use again to re-armour. 10s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.armor_release.short: Sheds the armour: faster, but you take more damage.
skill.jojoha.afterimages.desc: Armour off only. Chariot splits into 5 afterimages for 10 seconds, and each attack has a 40% chance to strike one instead of you. 20s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.afterimages.short: Armour off: afterimages may take hits meant for you.
message.jojoha.chariot.armored: Silver Chariot has to shed its armour first.
message.jojoha.chariot.bladeless: Silver Chariot has lost its rapier. Pick it up, or wait for it to come back.
skill.jojoha.miniature_trap.desc: Strings a tripwire from the block you look at to the far side. The first through is entangled, 4 damage. 3s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.miniature_trap.short: Strings a tripwire that entangles the first through.
skill.jojoha.body_possession.desc: Steer the body you look at. Mob: 5 damage every 5s. Player: 3s, then 8 damage. Stand users at half health. 30s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.body_possession.short: Steer the body you look at and wear it down.
skill.jojoha.twenty_meter_emerald_splash: A sphere of tendrils 20 blocks round you. Anything moving inside is shot from every side. Lasts 20s. 60s cooldown.
A sphere of tendrils that shoots anything moving inside.
message.jojoha.miniature_trap.nothing_ac: Nothing across the way to tie it to.
message.jojoha.possession.taken_over: Your body has been taken over by %s!
message.jojoha.possession.too_far: The body got too far from your own.
message.jojoha.possession.expired: You are forced out of the body.
message.jojoha.possession.taken: Someone is already inside that body.
message.jojoha.possession.too_strong: Their will is too strong. Wear them down to half health first.
message.jojoha.possession.busy: Not while you're inside another body.
skill.jojoha.kick_flurry.desc: Replaces Barrage. Hold for kicks: 40 per 8 seconds, pushing and lifting. 18 to 24 in all. 7s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.kick_flurry.short: Hold for a stream of kicks that push and lift.
skill.jojoha.beatdown.desc: Replaces Grab. Holds a target within 4.5 blocks and hits 8 times for 2.2, then throws for 6. 9s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.time_stop_perfect.desc: Replaces Time Stop. Charges the same way, then stops time for 8 seconds instead of 5. Only a vampire can learn or use it. 40s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.time_stop_perfect.short: A longer Time Stop. Vampires only.
passive.jojoha.master_of_time.desc: Slowness, Mining Fatigue and Stun wear off 20% sooner on you.
skill.jojoha.muda_rush.desc: The Stand lays six afterimages of itself along a path, then rushes through them in order. Aimed at a target, they form a six-pointed star around it; aimed at nothing, a zigzag about 14 blocks ahead; while sneaking, a spiral that closes inward. Each hit deals 6, breaks guards and shields, and knocks targets up, each hit higher than the last. The last point launches highest and sends a tremor that gives Slowness II for 1.5 seconds. 10s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.muda_rush.short: Lays six afterimages, then rushes through them juggling foes.
skill.jojoha.greatest_high.desc: Ultimate mode, ready after 30 seconds of unbroken combat. Stand blows deal 1.2x damage, growing 4% every second up to 2.5x. Ends when the fight does, or press again. 90s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.greatest_high.short: Ultimate mode: Stand damage keeps climbing while you fight.
skill.jojoha.heaven_time_stop.desc: Stops time across the whole dimension for 15 seconds, and everyone in it is told. Anyone who can still move in it slows down, halving their speed every 1.5 seconds. You cannot attack or use other moves while it holds. 60s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.heaven_time_stop.short: A long time stop that slows even those who can move in it.
skill.jojoha.infinite_servitude.desc: Every mob within 18 blocks, passive or hostile, serves you for 60 seconds. Servants hunt other players within 24 blocks and follow you otherwise; their colour drains away while they serve. 90s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.infinite_servitude.short: Every mob nearby serves you and hunts other players.
skill.jojoha.restoration.desc: Heals the creature you look at, up to 27 blocks away, to full and clears its harmful effects; a player also gets their hunger and armor restored. Sneak while using it to restore yourself instantly instead, at the cost of a 3 minute cooldown. Aimed at nothing, it brings back the last player or creature that died within 7 blocks of that spot in the past 5 minutes. A player returns there with their inventory and levels; a creature returns but drops nothing when it dies again. 35s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.restoration.short: Fully heals the creature you look at, or revives the fallen.
skill.jojoha.erasure.desc: For 3.5 seconds the world drains to grey around you while cracks spread and a void dome rises. Then reality inverts and everything within 30 blocks is erased: every block in the sphere vanishes into a hollow crater for 20 seconds, then the world knits itself back together from the rim inward, exactly as it was. Ordinary mobs at 40% health or less are unmade outright and still drop their loot. Everyone else loses their good effects and absorption, freezes for 1.5 seconds, has their Stand locked for 8 seconds, then takes a 12 rewrite hit. You drift down slowly. 60s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.erasure.short: Unmakes weak mobs and freezes the rest for a heavy hit.
skill.jojoha.overwrite.desc: Needs a full Ascension Gauge. For 6 seconds days and nights race past and the screen tears. Then the world flashes white and is rewritten: a wave of rewritten reality rolls out 64 blocks, and inside it the world is seen as heaven sees it - gold and white, threaded with glowing lines along every block, flickering where reality has not settled - for 30 seconds before it closes back in. Gravity flips for everything within 46 blocks, lifting it into the air before slamming it down, and the weather turns. Reality is rewritten for the whole dimension: every other Stand in it is put away for 30 seconds, with a 30% chance to take on a different skin. Empties the gauge. 120s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.overwrite.short: Slams everyone nearby and puts every other Stand away.
skill.jojoha.reality_bend.desc: Automatic. When you would die, the last 10 seconds within 32 blocks play back in reverse: blocks, creatures, players, drops and health. You rise at full health with Health Boost II for 60 seconds. Once every 5 minutes, and no more than 3 times per life.
skill.jojoha.reality_bend.short: Automatic. Death rewinds the world and you rise again.
passive.jojoha.boss_presence.desc: 1.5x maximum Stand stamina, stuns on you last half as long and Heaven moves reach 15% farther. In return you take 15% more damage and glow while your Stand is out.
passive.jojoha.ascended.desc: At 50% Ascension: your Stand punches 30% faster, its blows pull targets in instead of knocking them away, and cooldowns are 15% shorter.
passive.jojoha.transcendent.desc: At 75% Ascension: every move you use grants Resistance II for 1.5 seconds. Keeps Ascended.
passive.jojoha.heaven.desc: At 100% Ascension: unlocks Overwrite and wraps you in an immense aura. Keeps Ascended and Transcendent.
passive.jojoha.ascension_gauge.desc: Fills as you deal damage, block hits, land moves and stop time, and drains out of combat. 50% is Ascended, 75% Transcendent, 100% Heaven.
passive.jojoha.reality_is_mine.desc: Each blow has a 25% chance to overwrite what it touches: nearby projectiles are erased, mobs freeze for 2 seconds, a player's held items lock for 3 seconds, the target is pulled toward you and the ground beneath may change or break.
message.jojoha.heaven.no_attacks: You cannot attack in Heaven's stopped time
message.jojoha.heaven.greatest_high_lock: Greatest High needs a longer fight
message.jojoha.heaven.overwrite_locked: Overwrite needs a full Ascension Gauge
message.jojoha.heaven.overwrite_running: Overwrite is already rewriting the world
announce.jojoha.heaven_awoken: The World Over Heaven has awoken!
announce.jojoha.heaven_time_stop: The World Over Heaven has stopped time!
announce.jojoha.heaven_overwrite: The World Over Heaven is overwriting reality!
announce.jojoha.heaven_greatest_high: The World Over Heaven has reached its Greatest High!
passive.jojoha.crushing_force.desc: Below 25% health, blows against a guard deal 1.25x damage and knock a raised shield down.
passive.jojoha.deadeye.desc: Ranged attacks hit harder the farther they were thrown from: nothing extra inside 8 blocks, up to 1.25x at 24.
passive.jojoha.opportunist.desc: Ranged attacks deal 1.2x damage to anything busy fighting someone else.
passive.jojoha.splash_fragments.desc: A shard that hits has a 25% chance to burst through into 4 fragments at 40% damage, flying on along its line.
passive.jojoha.piercing_thrust.desc: Sword hits have a 25% chance to ignore 25% more of the target's armor. A fully charged Sabre Cycle, or any hit on a stunned or guard-broken target, always ignores 40% more.
passive.jojoha.duelists_focus.desc: Raising Silver Chariot's guard opens a 4-tick parry before it settles into a block. The parry turns melee hits and projectiles.
passive.jojoha.rebound.desc: Shards ricochet off the first block they hit, at 80% damage. Bank them off walls to reach round corners.
skill.jojoha.inhale.desc: Hold to pull everything within 14 blocks to you for 8 seconds. Puts out fire, cools lava. Sneak to blow. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.time_stop.desc: Hold to charge. When the bar fills, time stops for 5 seconds. Letting go early cancels it, and a hit breaks the charge. While time is stopped, right-click with a weapon to have your Stand throw it, and it flies once time moves again. 3 uses a fight. 20s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.time_stop_extended.desc: Replaces Time Stop. Charges the same way, then stops time for 6 seconds instead of 5. 35s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.time_skip.desc: Steps 12 blocks forward through stopped time. Needs Time Stop. 2.5s cooldown.
item.jojoha.ancient_bow.fires: The only bow that can loose a Stand Arrow.
jukebox_song.jojoha.last_train_home: Pat Metheny Group - Last Train Home
jukebox_song.jojoha.sono_chi_no_kioku: JO☆STARS - Sono Chi no Kioku ~end of THE WORLD~
jukebox_song.jojoha.sono_chi_no_sadame: Hiroaki "TOMMY" Tominaga - Sono Chi no Sadame
jukebox_song.jojoha.walk_like_an_egyptia: The Bangles - Walk Like an Egyptian
block.jojoha.labyrinth_door.locked: Locked. It needs a Labyrinth Key.
block.jojoha.boss_summoning_totem.waitin: The totem is cold. It wants a rare offering.
block.jojoha.boss_summoning_totem.lit: The offering is taken. The totem burns.
message.jojoha.catacombs.sealed: The fog will not part. %s spawners still burn.
message.jojoha.catacombs.sealed.one: The fog will not part. One spawner still burns.
message.jojoha.catacombs.cleared: The catacombs fall silent. The fog lifts.
config.jojoha.spawner_wave_size.tooltip: How many mobs a Dungeon Spawner calls up in each wave.
config.jojoha.spawner_wave_delay.tooltip: How long a Dungeon Spawner rests after its last wave has been killed.
config.jojoha.spawner_range.tooltip: How close, in blocks, a player has to be for a Dungeon Spawner to start its waves.
config.jojoha.spawner_waves.tooltip: How many waves a Dungeon Spawner calls up before it goes empty. The catacombs keep their fog door shut and block teleports out until every spawner outside the vaults is empty; their Mining Fatigue weakens as spawners go out.
config.jojoha.clacker_throw_damage.toolt: Damage from each ball when thrown Clackers hit, before the combat damage multiplier.
config.jojoha.clacker_spin_damage.toolti: Damage from each ball at full spin speed. A spin starts at just under half of this and builds up over three seconds.
config.jojoha.tnt_barrel_damage.tooltip: The most a TNT Barrel blast can deal to anything caught in it.
config.jojoha.loot_labyrinth_keys.toolti: How often labyrinth chests hold a Labyrinth Key.
config.jojoha.loot_anubis.tooltip: Multiplies how often Anubis turns up in desert pyramid chests.
config.jojoha.loot_stat_crystals.tooltip: Multiplies how often Equalizer Crystals turn up in chests and drop from vampires.
config.jojoha.loot_accessories.tooltip: Multiplies how often accessories and charms turn up in chests. Labyrinth chests hold them most often; commoner rarities turn up more.
config.jojoha.loot_bizarre_finds.tooltip: Multiplies how often a chest looted by a Bizarre player holds something extra.
skills.jojoha.ultimate.desc: Beyond vampire and Pillar Man. Sunlight is nothing to you now, and you take on the powers of any creature you study.
move.jojoha.ultimate_strength.desc: Reinforce your muscles with Strength for 10 seconds. Strength I at first, and II from Evolution rank 3. Costs 30. 45s cooldown.
move.jojoha.ultimate_strength.short: Reinforces your muscles with Strength for a while.
move.jojoha.adaptive_flight.desc: Your arms morph into wings, or back. Jump again in the air to take flight and steer like an Elytra. Jump while flying to flap forward for 3, and Sneak to fold out of flight. Costs 10 to open and 1.5 a second in the air. Once folded away, the wings need 20 seconds to grow back.
move.jojoha.adaptive_flight.short: Arms become wings; double jump to fly, Jump to flap.
move.jojoha.adapt.desc: Study a creature within 16 blocks for 3 seconds without looking away to add it to your Adaptations. Studying a different one of the same kind deepens your mastery, up to 3. Sneak and press to open your Adaptations. Costs 15. 5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.adapt.short: Study a creature to add its power to your Adaptations.
move.jojoha.adapted_ability.desc: Use the creature power in your first active Adaptation slot. Its cost and cooldown depend on the creature, and mastery shortens the cooldown.
move.jojoha.adapted_ability.short: Uses the creature power in your first Adaptation slot.
spec_passive.jojoha.perfect_biology.desc: Immune to Poison, Wither, Hunger, Slowness, Weakness, Nausea, Mining Fatigue, Blindness, Infested and Oozing.
message.jojoha.adapt.nothing: There is nothing to learn from that creature.
message.jojoha.adapt.studying: Studying the %s. Keep your eyes on it.
move.jojoha.adapted_ability_2.desc: Use the creature power in your second active Adaptation slot. The slot opens at Evolution rank 2.
move.jojoha.adapted_ability_2.short: Uses the creature power in your second Adaptation slot.
move.jojoha.adapted_ability_3.desc: Use the creature power in your third active Adaptation slot. The slot opens at Evolution rank 5.
move.jojoha.adapted_ability_3.short: Uses the creature power in your third Adaptation slot.
message.jojoha.adapt.fully_mastered: You have nothing left to learn from that creature.
message.jojoha.adapt.same_creature: You learned all you could from this %s. Study another one.
message.jojoha.adapt.slot_locked: That Adaptation slot has not opened yet.
screen.jojoha.adaptations.active_empty: Left-click an Adaptation to use its power here.
screen.jojoha.adaptations.passive_empty: Right-click an Adaptation to wear its defence here.
screen.jojoha.adaptations.unknown_hint: Study the creature with Adapt to learn it.
screen.jojoha.adaptations.full: Those slots are full. Click a slot to empty it.
screen.jojoha.adaptations.perks: Rank %s: +%s health, +%s armour, +%s attack. Ultimate Strength %s.
adaptation.jojoha.detonate.passive: When badly hurt, blast nearby enemies away. Once every 30s.
adaptation.jojoha.venom_web.passive: Melee attackers are slowed and poisoned.
adaptation.jojoha.fangs.passive: When badly hurt, fangs erupt around you. Once every 30s.
adaptation.jojoha.wither_skull.passive: Take less damage below half health.
adaptation.jojoha.elder_beam.passive: Stronger thorns, and melee attackers get Mining Fatigue.
adaptation.jojoha.shulker_bullet.passive: Sneaking closes your shell for extra armour.
adaptation.jojoha.wind_burst.passive: A chance to deflect projectiles back.
adaptation.jojoha.sonic_boom.passive: Knockback resistance, and Darkness cannot touch you.
adaptation.jojoha.blink.passive: A chance to teleport away from a hit. Once every 10s.
adaptation.jojoha.roar.passive: Resist melee hits and some knockback.
adaptation.jojoha.spikes.passive: Thorns, and melee attackers are poisoned.
adaptation.jojoha.trident.passive: Breathe longer underwater and resist drowning.
message.jojoha.ultimate.no_stand: Your perfect body rejects any Stand.
message.jojoha.ultimate.stand_lost: Your perfect body casts out your Stand.
config.jojoha.ultimate_strength_level.to: Level of the Strength effect Ultimate Strength gives. Each level adds 3 melee damage.
config.jojoha.wing_drain.tooltip: Energy Adaptive Flight drains each second while you are flying.
config.jojoha.wing_flap_cost.tooltip: Energy each flap of Adaptive Flight costs.
skills.jojoha.pillar.desc: The kit of the men in the pillars. Flesh that takes in flesh, a body that bends any way, and the Modes written in their books. Sunlight turns you to stone.
skilltree.jojoha.unlock_pillar.desc: Opens the Pillar Man tree. Its moves need you to be a Pillar Man. The Ultimate Lifeform keeps it.
skilltree.jojoha.path_wind_mode.desc: Wamuu's Mode. Gales and tornadoes from the hands. Learned from the Wind Mode Book.
skilltree.jojoha.path_heat_mode.desc: Esidisi's Mode. Blood boiled past 500 degrees, sent through the vessels. Learned from the Heat Mode Book.
skilltree.jojoha.path_light_mode.desc: Kars' Mode. Bone blades that shine like light. Learned from the Light Mode Book.
move.jojoha.infiltrate.desc: Melt into a mob or player within 3 blocks and take over their body: walk, look and strike as them. Inside, only Hamon can hurt you, and you drain 1.5 a second. Mobs: 15s. Players: 3s, once worn to half health if they have powers. Press again to burst out of their back for 8 and Bleed. Not bosses. Costs 25. 15s cooldown.
move.jojoha.infiltrate.short: Melt into a body and take it over; burst out to wound it.
move.jojoha.contortion.desc: Toggle. Melt into a crawling mass of flesh: ooze through 1-block gaps and squeeze between iron bars, panes and fences. Drains 2.4 energy a second.
move.jojoha.contortion.short: Toggle. Become crawling flesh that oozes through gaps.
move.jojoha.rib_blades.desc: Ribs burst out of your torso. 6 damage and Bleed to everything within 2 blocks. Costs 18. 6s cooldown.
move.jojoha.rib_blades.short: Ribs burst out, cutting everything around you.
move.jojoha.divine_sandstorm.desc: Wind Mode. Your forearm spins into a vortex 8 blocks long. 7 damage to everything in the line, flinging them on, and it tears projectiles out of the air. Costs 28. 8s cooldown.
move.jojoha.divine_sandstorm.short: Wind Mode. A forearm vortex that flings what is in its line.
move.jojoha.gale_cut.desc: Wind Mode. Flicks a gust up to 14 blocks. 4 damage to the first thing hit, then it bursts like a Wind Charge. Aim at your feet to launch yourself. Costs 12. 2.5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.gale_cut.short: Wind Mode. A gust that bursts on the first thing it hits.
move.jojoha.tornado.desc: Wind Mode. Spins a tornado in your hand and sends it along the ground for 3.5s. Hold the key to steer it toward where you look; let go and it carries on straight. It lifts and spins whatever it touches for 3 damage a second. Costs 30. 12s cooldown.
move.jojoha.tornado.short: Wind Mode. Hold to steer a tornado that lifts what it touches.
move.jojoha.wind_cloak.desc: Wind Mode. Toggle. Bends the air around you: projectiles are turned aside, and you vanish after standing still for half a second. Drains 4 energy a second.
move.jojoha.wind_cloak.short: Wind Mode. Toggle. Turns projectiles; stand still to vanish.
move.jojoha.atmospheric_rift.desc: Wind Mode. Pressurised air bursts out through your arms as blades. 10 damage and Bleed to everything in a cone 10 blocks ahead. Costs you 6 health and 45. 60s cooldown.
move.jojoha.atmospheric_rift.short: Wind Mode. Air blades tear a wide cone, at a cost in health.
move.jojoha.boiling_blood_needles.desc: Heat Mode. Vessels lance out to 6 blocks into up to 3 targets ahead. 5 damage each and a stack of Burning. Costs 20. 6s cooldown.
move.jojoha.boiling_blood_needles.short: Heat Mode. Vessels lance into the targets ahead.
move.jojoha.vessel_grab.desc: Heat Mode. Vessels latch onto one target within 8 blocks and drag it to you. 2 damage and a stack of Burning. Bosses aren't moved. Costs 14. 5s cooldown.
move.jojoha.vessel_grab.short: Heat Mode. Vessels drag one target to you.
move.jojoha.heat_body.desc: Heat Mode. Toggle. Your blood runs boiling: anything that hits you in melee catches Burning, snow and ice melt around you, and you can't freeze. Drains 4.4 energy a second.
move.jojoha.heat_body.short: Heat Mode. Toggle. Melee attackers burn and you can't freeze.
move.jojoha.crying_vent.desc: Heat Mode. You weep the heat away, rooted for 1.5s. Then every harmful effect and fire on you is gone and you heal 2 hearts. Costs 20. 20s cooldown.
move.jojoha.crying_vent.short: Heat Mode. Root briefly, then cleanse and heal.
move.jojoha.brilliant_blades.desc: Light Mode. Toggle. Bone blades out of your forearms. Bare-hand hits reach half a block further, and every third one Bleeds. Drains 3.6 energy a second.
move.jojoha.brilliant_blades.short: Light Mode. Toggle. Forearm blades with longer reach.
move.jojoha.shining_slash.desc: Light Mode. Dashes 6 blocks, cutting everything you pass for 8 and Bleed. Costs 22. 7s cooldown.
move.jojoha.shining_slash.short: Light Mode. A dash that cuts everything you pass.
move.jojoha.blade_flash.desc: Light Mode. Light flares off the blades. Everything within 10 blocks looking at you is blinded for 3s, and mobs lose track of you. Not bosses. Costs 16. 10s cooldown.
move.jojoha.blade_flash.short: Light Mode. Blinds everything looking at you.
move.jojoha.saw_grip.desc: Light Mode. Holds one target within 3 blocks in front of you while the blades saw along your arm. 3 hits of 3, the last one Bleeds. Bosses aren't held. Costs 20. 8s cooldown.
move.jojoha.saw_grip.short: Light Mode. Holds one target and saws it.
spec_passive.jojoha.flesh_absorption.des: Bare-hand hits heal you 1. A zombie that strikes you is absorbed instead: it takes 4 and you heal 2.
spec_passive.jojoha.stone_in_sunlight.de: Daylight doesn't burn you, it petrifies you. You stiffen from 3 seconds and are stone at 10: you can't move, attack or use moves, and take half again as much damage until shade or night. A helmet shades you but wears down.
spec_passive.jojoha.wind_sense.desc: Wind Mode. Sneak to feel every creature within 12 blocks through the air. Falls are 6 blocks kinder.
spec_passive.jojoha.boiling_blood.desc: Heat Mode. Fire and campfires can't hurt you, though lava still does. +1 damage to anything burning.
spec_passive.jojoha.blade_guard.desc: Light Mode. Parrying with Brilliant Blades out Bleeds the attacker.
message.jojoha.path_scroll.not_pillar: Only a Pillar Man can read these pages.

passive.jojoha.grappling_vine_ii.short: Faster still, and falls hurt far less.
passive.jojoha.ripple_conduction.short: With Hamon, vine moves hit the undead harder.
passive.jojoha.combat_adaptation.short: Learns the attacks it meets and answers them.

passive.jojoha.unorthodox_method.short: This Stand grows by being out, not by kills.
passive.jojoha.master_of_time.short: Slowing effects and Stun wear off sooner.
passive.jojoha.boss_presence.short: More stamina and reach, but you take more damage.

passive.jojoha.transcendent.short: At 75% Ascension: every move grants Resistance.
passive.jojoha.ascension_gauge.short: Fills as you fight and unlocks three tiers.

spec_passive.jojoha.undead_physiology.sh: A dead body hits harder and moves faster.
spec_passive.jojoha.blood_mending.short: You heal over time, paid for in blood.
spec_passive.jojoha.sun_scorch.short: Daylight burns you. Stay in the shade.

spec_passive.jojoha.resolve.short: Worthiness adds luck and faster energy.
spec_passive.jojoha.flesh_absorption.sho: Bare-hand hits heal you. Zombies that hit you are absorbed.
spec_passive.jojoha.stone_in_sunlight.sh: Daylight turns you to stone instead of burning you.
spec_passive.jojoha.wind_sense.short: Sneak to sense nearby creatures. Softer falls.
spec_passive.jojoha.boiling_blood.short: Fire cannot hurt you. Burning targets take more.
fortune.jojoha.wicked.short: Creatures fear you, and players feel you coming.
fortune.jojoha.lucky.short: Better luck and finds, until your phobia breaks it.
fortune.jojoha.honorbound.short: Fair fights make you stronger. Cowardice weakens you.
fortune.jojoha.cursed.short: No blow takes your last half heart. Death leaves a spirit.
fortune.jojoha.idealogue.short: Duels make you stronger. Peace makes you restless.
trait.jojoha.two_right_hands.short: Melee attacks can strike a second time.
trait.jojoha.killers_luck.short: Some days you hit harder. Some days, nothing.

move.jojoha.dodge.short: A short hop the way you are going.
move.jojoha.ground_slam.short: Drives you down. Hurts more the farther you fall.
move.jojoha.burst.short: A hard shove where you are looking.
item.jojoha.progenitor_mask.desc: Press it to your face. You stay human until a vampire kills you.
message.jojoha.progenitor_mask.worn: The mask sinks into your face and is gone. You are still human, for now.
message.jojoha.progenitor_mask.unworthy: The mask only takes a human face.
message.jojoha.progenitor_mask.already: Its mark is already in your blood.
message.jojoha.pillar_birth.collapsed: Your body comes apart into blood. Something in it is still alive.
message.jojoha.pillar_birth.reformed: Your body pulls itself back together. You are a Pillar Man now.
message.jojoha.pillar_birth.born: You were born with Pillar Man blood. Sunlight will turn you to stone.
config.jojoha.pillar_start.tooltip: The chance that a player joining for the first time starts as a Pillar Man.
skill.jojoha.heavens_uppercut.desc: The Stand winds up for half a second, then throws one huge uppercut that deals 14, breaks guards and shields, staggers, and launches the target about 8 blocks up. 6s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.heavens_uppercut.short: A wound-up uppercut that launches the target high.
skill.jojoha.judgement_fist.desc: Hold to charge for up to 2 seconds, then the Stand punches a line of light toward whatever you aim at that passes through everything in it. The longer the charge, the more it deals (8 to 20), the further it reaches (7 to 18 blocks) and the harder it knocks back. A full charge also breaks guards and shields. 4 to 7s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.judgement_fist.short: Charge, then punch a line of light through everything you aim at.
skill.jojoha.heaven_step.desc: Skips time to land just behind the creature you look at, up to 18 blocks away, and the Stand strikes it for 11, breaking guards and staggering it. Needs a target and room to land. 5s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.heaven_step.short: Skip behind your target and strike.
skill.jojoha.knife_halo.desc: Hold to raise a ring of 12 knives of golden light behind you, turning while you hold, for up to 5 seconds. Let go and they all fire at the creature you look at, or straight ahead. Each knife deals 5 and causes Bleed. Needs no knives of your own. 8s cooldown.
skill.jojoha.knife_halo.short: Hold to spin a ring of golden knives, release to fire them.
message.jojoha.heaven.stand_erased: Your Stand has been erased for a moment
message.jojoha.heaven.step_blocked: There is no room behind that target
message.jojoha.bleed.out: Bleeding out! Milk, Herbal Tea, healing or Hamon breathing slows it
speech.jojoha.time_stop.the_world_over_h: The World Over Heaven! Time, stop!
speech.jojoha.time_resumed: Time has begun to move again.
speech.jojoha.stand_spent: Gah... my %s ran out of energy...
trait.jojoha.keen_eyes.desc: Invisible creatures within 8 blocks show to you as a faint shape.
trait.jojoha.keen_eyes.short: You see the invisible up close.
trait.jojoha.iron_stomach.desc: Food never harms you: rotten flesh, spider eyes and poisonous potatoes give no ill effect. As a vampire you draw 10% more blood.
trait.jojoha.deep_breath.desc: You hold your breath 50% longer underwater, and with Hamon your bar refills 10% faster.
trait.jojoha.playing_dead.desc: Below 20% health, hold still while sneaking for 3 seconds and mobs hunting you lose interest. Bosses and players are not fooled.
trait.jojoha.playing_dead.short: Hold still when hurt and mobs forget you.
trait.jojoha.steady_hand.desc: Your thrown weapons and arrows fly 15% faster and farther, without hitting harder.
fortune.jojoha.trickster.desc: When someone aims a move at you, you see its icon over them before it lands. Thrown things you hit with stun for half a second, and your parry window is a tick longer. Straight fights go badly: your first three melee hits in a fight deal 20% less, unless you parry, dodge or land a throw first.
fortune.jojoha.trickster.short: See moves coming. Win with tricks, not fists.
fortune.jojoha.kindred.desc: Animals never flee from you. Sneak beside a wild animal you could tame for 3 seconds and it is yours, no food needed. While your Stand is out your pets gain Strength and can strike Stands. Hurting a passive animal leaves you Weakened for a minute, and killing one makes your sight shudder for a day.
fortune.jojoha.kindred.short: Animals trust you. Harming them haunts you.
fortune.jojoha.gambler.desc: Sneak while using an Equalizer Crystal or Stand Arrow, or while opening an unlooted chest bare-handed, to call double or nothing. Win and the Crystal moves 2 more levels, the Arrow rolls twice, or the chest fills again. Lose and the item is spent, or a third of the chest is gone. Sneak-use a player and say anything in chat to wager it. If they bet a held item against your word, the first to fall loses: win and the item is yours, fall and it goes back to them and you owe what you said. Losing a spoken wager, refusing a Gambler's wager, or leaving mid-duel sets your Luck to -1 for a day.
fortune.jojoha.gambler.short: Sneak to call double or nothing.
fortune.jojoha.devout.desc: Fate visits you more often, and wishes cost a quarter less. You live by five vows. Each day you keep them all earns 1 Faith (up to 5): every point makes wishes 5% cheaper and Calm Mind a minute quicker, and at 5 Faith a killing blow leaves you at half a heart instead, spending it all. Breaking a vow loses all Faith and lights a guilt candle that raises wish prices; one burns out every 3 days. Below 30% health, sneak and hold still to count primes and clear Weakness, Slowness and Nausea.
fortune.jojoha.devout.short: Keep five vows for Faith. Breaking one lights a guilt candle.
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.name_stak: Name your stake to %s in chat. Anything you like.
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.offered: %s wagers "%s". Sneak and use an item on them to bet it.
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.set: The wager is set: %s against "%s". Fate holds the item.
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.paid: You win. %s comes back to you, and you are owed "%s".
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.owed: You lost. You owe "%s", and your luck turns.
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.drawn: No one fell. %s goes back to its owner.
message.jojoha.fortune.gambler.refused: You walked away from a wager. Your luck turns.
message.jojoha.fortune.devout.broke: You broke your vow of %s. A guilt candle is lit. (%s)
message.jojoha.fortune.devout.kept: Your vows held another day. Faith: %s
message.jojoha.fortune.devout.sabbath: Today is the Sabbath. Raise no hand.
message.jojoha.fortune.devout.fast: Today is a fast day. Eat no meat or fish.
message.jojoha.fortune.devout.miracle: A miracle. Your Faith is spent.
fortune.jojoha.devout.vow.mercy.desc: Kill nothing that hasn't threatened you. Hostile monsters, anything targeting you, and anything that hurt you in the last 30 seconds are fair.
No ambushes: don't strike while invisible or crouching, or hit a creature from behind before it has threatened you.
fortune.jojoha.devout.vow.abstinence.des: On fast days (the 3rd and 5th of every 7), eat no meat or fish.
fortune.jojoha.devout.vow.sabbath.desc: Every 7th day is holy: harm nothing at all.
fortune.jojoha.devout.vow.pure_blood.des: Stay human. Becoming a vampire or Pillar Man, or wearing a Stone Mask, breaks this vow every day it lasts.
message.jojoha.fortune.devout.forgiven: A guilt candle burns out. (%s left)
fortune.jojoha.sense.scent.desc: Your world goes black, but you can smell it. Hold still or sneak to sniff: the scent spreads out to 10 blocks and the edges it reaches appear, then fade from memory. Moving dulls your nose. Living things give off a cloud of scent you can see, and players leave a trail you can follow. Whoever hurts you gives themselves away for a few seconds.
fortune.jojoha.sense.hearing.desc: Your world goes black, but you can hear it. Every sound within 24 blocks sends out a wave that lights up the edges it passes, then they fade from memory; louder sounds reach farther. Living things puff out smoke with each heartbeat, and their footsteps kick up more unless they sneak. Whoever hurts you gives themselves away for a few seconds.
message.jojoha.curse.sense_offer: Your eyes are gone. Lean on another sense (this cannot be undone):

npc.jojoha.hamon_student.ask_vampires: What do you know about vampires?
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.hamon: It's a breathing technique. Breathe the right way and your body makes energy like sunlight. Vampires hate it. We're still learning, though.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.vampires: They drink blood and burn in the sun. Some are fast, some can freeze you, and a few can raise zombies. Red moons bring a lot of them out.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.smell: You're a vampire! Stay away from us!
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.traitor: You killed one of us. Get out of here!
npc.jojoha.stand_user.honourable.call: Hey, %s. You've got a Stand, don't you?
npc.jojoha.stand_user.hostile.call: Hey! %s! Don't you walk away from me!
npc.jojoha.stand_user.trickster.call: Oh, %s! Fancy running into you here.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.honourable.offer: I want to see how strong your Stand is. Fair fight, nobody dies. What do you say?
npc.jojoha.stand_user.hostile.offer: I've been looking for a fight. You, me, right here. Well?
npc.jojoha.stand_user.trickster.offer: Want to have a quick duel? Just for fun. I'll go easy on you.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.accepted: Alright, show me what you've got, %s!
npc.jojoha.stand_user.trickster.ambush: Did you really think I'd let you go?
npc.jojoha.stand_user.yield: Okay, okay, I give up! Here, you won this, %s.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.victory: That's enough. Not bad, but you lost.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.farewell: I've got nothing to say to you.
event.jojoha.vampire_raid.won: The village is safe. The villagers will remember this.
npc.jojoha.gift.disliked: Uh... why would you give me this?
npc.jojoha.gift.later: You already gave me something today.
quest.jojoha.slay_vampires.offer: Vampires have been attacking people on the roads. Could you take out three of them? I'll pay you.
quest.jojoha.slay_vampires.taken: Thanks. Any of us can pay you when you're done.
quest.jojoha.slay_vampires.progress: There are still a few out there. Be careful.
quest.jojoha.slay_vampires.done: You got all three? Nice work.

quest.jojoha.slay_vampires.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student. Return to any of them.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.task_declined: That's fine. Let me know if you change your mind.
