quest.jojoha.hunt.near: %s is close by. Your tracker shows where it was last seen.
quest.jojoha.hunt.escaped: Someone else killed %s. Another one will turn up.
quest.jojoha.thin_the_dead.name: Undead Cleanup
quest.jojoha.thin_the_dead.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student. Return to any of them.
quest.jojoha.thin_the_dead.offer: There are way too many zombies and skeletons around at night. Could you clear out ten of them?
quest.jojoha.thin_the_dead.taken: Great. Anything undead counts, except vampires.
quest.jojoha.thin_the_dead.progress: There are still too many of them out there.
quest.jojoha.thin_the_dead.done: That's ten? It should be quieter now.
quest.jojoha.rations.name: Bread Run
quest.jojoha.rations.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student. Return to any of them.
quest.jojoha.rations.return: Bring the bread to a Hamon Student
quest.jojoha.rations.offer: Training makes us really hungry, and we're out of food. Could you bring us eight loaves of bread?
quest.jojoha.rations.taken: Thank you! Any village should have some.
quest.jojoha.rations.progress: No bread yet? I'm starving here.
quest.jojoha.sun_harvest.name: Golden Carrots
quest.jojoha.sun_harvest.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student. Return to any of them.
quest.jojoha.sun_harvest.return: Bring the carrots to a Hamon Student
quest.jojoha.sun_harvest.offer: Our teacher says golden carrots help with breathing training. Could you get me six?
quest.jojoha.sun_harvest.taken: Thanks! You'll need gold nuggets and carrots.
quest.jojoha.sun_harvest.progress: I still need those golden carrots.
quest.jojoha.cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
quest.jojoha.cold_blood.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student. Return to any of them.
quest.jojoha.cold_blood.offer: There's a kind of vampire that can freeze you solid. Hamon doesn't work well on it. Could you kill one for us?
quest.jojoha.cold_blood.taken: Don't stand still near it. That's when it gets you.
quest.jojoha.cold_blood.progress: That frost vampire is still out there.
quest.jojoha.cold_blood.done: You actually killed one? That's amazing.
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.name: Hold Out Till Dawn
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.goal: Stay alive until the Vampire Night ends
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student during a Vampire Night.
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.failed: You died before dawn. Hold Out Till Dawn failed.
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.offer: It's a red moon. There are going to be a lot of vampires tonight. Will you stay with us until morning?
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.taken: Okay. Just don't die before the sun comes up.
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.progress: Hang in there, it's almost morning!
quest.jojoha.hold_the_line.done: We made it! Thanks for sticking around.
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.name: Star Scrap
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student after a Meteor Shower.
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.return: Bring the scrap to a Hamon Student
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.offer: Did you see the meteors? Our teacher wants some of the metal. Could you bring me three pieces of meteorite scrap?
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.progress: No scrap yet? Someone else might grab it first.
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.done: Is that the meteorite? It's still warm.
quest.jojoha.fallen_star.thanks: Our teacher's going to love this. Here.
quest.jojoha.nameless_sire.name: Sire Hunt
quest.jojoha.nameless_sire.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student who trusts you.
quest.jojoha.nameless_sire.offer: Those vampires you killed were working for a Sire. It raises zombies to fight for it. Could you track it down?
quest.jojoha.nameless_sire.taken: It'll probably have zombies with it. Watch out.
quest.jojoha.nameless_sire.progress: The Sire is still out there.
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.name: The Raid Leader
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.goal: Hunt down the Ravager that led the raid
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student after a Vampire Raid.
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.offer: The vampire that led the raid ran off before it ended. It's a Ravager, really fast. Could you hunt it down before it comes back?
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.taken: Don't let it get close. It hits hard.
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.progress: The raid leader is still out there.
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.done: It's dead? Good. The village can relax now.
quest.jojoha.raid_butcher.thanks: This is from all of us. Thanks.
npc.jojoha.gift.tip_later: You've already given them something today
menu.jojoha.quests.none_of_type: You have no quests of this type.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.ask_standing: How do the others see me?
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.standing.hated: Honestly? Half the Society wants you gone. I'd keep my distance if I were you.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.standing.hostil: People here don't trust you. You've hurt some of us, and that sticks.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.standing.neutra: Most of us don't really know you yet. Help out a bit and that'll change.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.standing.friend: You've got a good name around here. People bring you up when you're not around.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.standing.honour: As far as anyone here's concerned, you're one of us. Even our teacher asks about you.
npc.jojoha.trait.cheerful.about: Always in a good mood, and loves a laugh.
npc.jojoha.talk.open.cheerful: Ooh, yes! What do you want to talk about?
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet.cheerful: Hi there! Don't mind the undead, we've got it handled. Mostly.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet_friend.ch: Hey, it's you! I was hoping you'd come by today, §cfriend§r!
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.cheerful.0: I'd love to keep going, but I really have to get back to training. Tomorrow?
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.cheerful.1: Ha, I think I've run out of things to say. That never happens!
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.chat.good.0: Isn't it a lovely day? Even the zombies seem slower today.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.chat.good.1: I know, right? I could talk about this all day.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.chat.bad.0: Ha, yeah... sorry, I lost track of what you were saying.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.joke.good.0: Hahaha! Oh, that's so bad. Tell me another one!
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.joke.good.1: Pfft! I'm going to tell that one to everybody.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.joke.bad.0: Ha... hm. I'll laugh at the next one, promise.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.joke.bad.1: Oh! Oh, I get it. Kind of.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.compliment.good: Aww, you're sweet! You just made my whole day.
Really? Thank you! You're not so bad yourself.
Ha, okay, okay, you can stop now.
Oh! Um, thanks! That's a lot, though.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.ask.good.0: Me? I grew up on a farm. I still wake up before the roosters.
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.ask.good.1: I just like helping people. Hamon lets me do that and punch zombies. Win-win!
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.ask.bad.0: Ugh, my story's boring. Let's talk about something fun instead!
npc.jojoha.talk.cheerful.ask.bad.1: Oh, I don't really like talking about that stuff. Ask me something else!
npc.jojoha.trait.serious.about: Focused on training. Doesn't have much time for fooling around.
npc.jojoha.talk.open.serious: Alright. Keep it short, I'm due back at training.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet.serious: Stay alert. The undead have been moving in closer every night.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet_friend.se: Good, you're here. I could use someone reliable, §cfriend§r.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.serious.0: That's enough talking for one day. I need to get back to work.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.serious.1: We can continue this tomorrow. I have drills to finish.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.chat.good.0: Fair point. I hadn't thought of it that way.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.chat.good.1: Hm. That's worth keeping in mind.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.chat.bad.0: Is there a reason you're telling me this?
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.chat.bad.1: I don't really have time for small talk.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.joke.good.1: Don't tell anyone I laughed at that.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.joke.bad.0: Is that meant to be funny?
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.joke.bad.1: We're fighting vampires out here. Jokes can wait.
Thanks. I've worked hard to get here.
I appreciate that. It means the training is paying off.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.compliment.bad.0: Flattery won't get you anywhere with me.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.compliment.bad.1: Save it. I know where I need to improve.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.ask.good.0: A vampire took my village. I train so that never happens to anyone else.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.ask.good.1: Our teacher pushes me harder than anyone. I asked her to.
npc.jojoha.talk.serious.ask.bad.1: I'd rather keep that to myself.
npc.jojoha.trait.shy.about: Quiet and nervous around new people. Warms up slowly.
npc.jojoha.talk.open.shy: Oh! Um, sure. What did you want to talk about?
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet.shy: Oh, um... hi. Be careful, there are undead around...
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet_friend.sh: Oh, hey! It's nice to see you, §cfriend§r. Really.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.shy.0: Um, I think I need some quiet time now. Sorry.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.shy.1: I'm kind of talked out. Can we talk again tomorrow?
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.chat.good.0: Yeah... yeah, I think so too. This is nice.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.chat.good.1: I don't usually talk this much. It's easy with you, though.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.chat.bad.0: Um... yeah. Sorry, I don't know what to say.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.joke.good.1: *snort* Oh no, sorry. That was funny.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.joke.bad.1: I'm sorry, I didn't get it...
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.compliment.good.0: Oh! I... thank you. Nobody really says that.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.compliment.bad.0: Please don't... I don't know what to do with that.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.compliment.bad.1: Um. You don't have to say that.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.ask.good.0: I keep a little notebook of everything I learn here. It helps me feel less behind.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.ask.good.1: I joined because my older brother did. He's much better at this than me.
npc.jojoha.talk.shy.ask.bad.0: Oh, um, there's not really much to say.
npc.jojoha.trait.proud.about: Confident in their skills, and likes being noticed for them.
npc.jojoha.talk.open.proud: Of course you want to talk to me. Go on.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet.proud: Don't worry about the undead. I'm the best fighter here.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet_friend.pr: Ah, my favourite person after myself. Welcome back, §cfriend§r!
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.proud.0: I have to keep my edge sharp. We're done for today.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.proud.1: I think you've had enough of my time for one day.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.chat.good.0: Exactly what I was going to say. Great minds.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.chat.good.1: You've got good sense. I like that.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.chat.bad.0: Can we talk about something interesting?
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.joke.good.0: Ha! Not bad. Almost as funny as me.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.joke.good.1: Alright, that got me. I'll allow it.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.joke.bad.0: I've heard better. I've told better.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.joke.bad.1: You should leave the jokes to me.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.compliment.good.0: I know. But it's nice to hear it out loud.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.compliment.good.1: Finally, someone who notices. Thank you.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.compliment.bad.0: Is that all? I was expecting more.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.compliment.bad.1: Only that? You must not have been watching closely.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.ask.good.0: I passed my first Hamon test faster than anyone in my year.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.ask.good.1: I'm going to be the teacher's top student one day. Watch.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.ask.bad.0: My story's not for just anyone.
npc.jojoha.talk.proud.ask.bad.1: You'll have to earn that one.
npc.jojoha.trait.curious.about: Full of questions. Loves hearing about other people.
npc.jojoha.talk.open.curious: Ooh, yes. Tell me something I don't know!
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet.curious: Oh, a new face! Where are you from? Wait, undead first. Be careful.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet_friend.cu: There you are! I've been saving up questions for you, §cfriend§r.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.curious.0: My head's full! I need to think about all this. Tomorrow?
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.curious.1: I've asked you way too much today. Let's pick it up later.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.chat.good.0: Really? How does that work? Tell me more!
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.chat.good.1: Huh, I never knew that. That's great.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.chat.bad.0: Hm. I think I've heard that one before.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.joke.good.0: Ha! Where did you hear that one?
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.joke.good.1: Heh, okay, explain why that's funny. No, wait, I get it.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.joke.bad.0: Hm, I don't get it. Is it a joke from where you're from?
Oh, thanks! What made you notice?
Ha, really? I wouldn't have guessed.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.compliment.bad.0: Thanks, but I'd rather hear about you.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.compliment.bad.1: That's nice, but tell me something about yourself.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.ask.good.0: Me? I'm much more interested in you, honestly.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.ask.good.1: Oh, I'm boring. Okay, fine, I collect strange rocks.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.ask.bad.0: Hm, I'd rather ask the questions.
npc.jojoha.talk.curious.ask.bad.1: Why do you want to know? Okay, now I'm curious.
npc.jojoha.trait.grumpy.about: Complains a lot, but means well underneath.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet.grumpy: What? Oh. Watch out for the undead, I guess. Not that anyone listens.
npc.jojoha.hamon_student.greet_friend.gr: Oh, it's you. ...I suppose that's fine, §cfriend§r.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.grumpy.0: Alright, I've talked enough for a week. Go away.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.grumpy.1: No more. Come back tomorrow, if you have to.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.chat.good.1: Fine, you're not as annoying as everyone else.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.chat.bad.1: Great. Wonderful. Can I go now?
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.joke.good.0: ...Pfft. Ugh, stop it. That was dumb.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.joke.good.1: Heh. Don't make that face, I didn't laugh.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.joke.bad.1: That's the worst thing I've heard all day.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.compliment.bad.1: Don't try to butter me up.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.ask.good.0: I never wanted to be a fighter. But someone has to do it, so here I am.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.ask.good.1: I bake bread when no one's looking. Tell anyone and you're dead.
npc.jojoha.talk.grumpy.ask.bad.0: Why does everyone want to know about me?
npc.jojoha.talk.game.good.0: Rock, paper... ha, I win! Again! Again!
npc.jojoha.talk.game.good.1: Aww, you beat me! Okay, rematch tomorrow.
npc.jojoha.talk.game.bad.0: Hmm, maybe not right now. Training soon.
npc.jojoha.talk.game.bad.1: Ha, I keep losing. Let's do something else.
npc.jojoha.talk.advice.good.0: Breathe from your stomach, not your chest. Everything else comes from that.
npc.jojoha.talk.advice.good.1: Never fight a vampire alone at night. Wait for the sun if you can.
npc.jojoha.talk.advice.bad.0: Figure it out yourself. That's how I learned.
npc.jojoha.talk.company.good.0: ...Thanks for staying. It's nice not to be alone.
npc.jojoha.talk.company.good.1: You don't have to say anything. This is good.
npc.jojoha.talk.company.bad.0: Um, it's kind of awkward when you just stand there...
npc.jojoha.talk.show_off.good.0: Watch this. See how the sparks run all the way up? Took me months.
npc.jojoha.talk.show_off.good.1: Ha! Look at that form. Perfect, right?
npc.jojoha.talk.show_off.bad.0: Hm, not with that kind of attitude.
npc.jojoha.talk.show_off.bad.1: I'm not a performing animal. Maybe later.
npc.jojoha.talk.travels.good.0: You walked all the way out there? What was it like? Tell me everything!
npc.jojoha.talk.travels.good.1: Wow. I've never been past the edge of the woods. Someday.
npc.jojoha.talk.travels.bad.0: Huh. Sounds like you got lost.
npc.jojoha.talk.travels.bad.1: That's it? I thought it would be more exciting.
npc.jojoha.talk.vent.good.0: Everyone keeps leaving their gear in my spot. Every day! ...Thanks for listening.
npc.jojoha.talk.vent.good.1: The zombies, the training, the food. All of it. ...Okay, I feel a bit better.
npc.jojoha.talk.vent.bad.1: I don't want to talk about it.
npc.jojoha.trait.hint: Become friends to learn what they like.
npc.jojoha.crusader.ask_dio: What do you know about Dio?
npc.jojoha.jotaro.vampire: You smell like one of Dio's. Walk away while you still can.
npc.jojoha.jotaro.stand: Star Platinum. It's fast, it's precise, and it hits hard. That's all you need to know.
npc.jojoha.jotaro.dio: He's the reason my mom is sick. I'm going to find him and end this. That's it.
npc.jojoha.jotaro.greet_friend: Oh. It's you. ...Good to see you, I guess.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.jotaro.0: Good grief. That's enough talking for today.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.jotaro.1: I'm done. Go bother the old man.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.chat.good.1: ...Not bad. You're less annoying than most.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.compliment.good.1: Hmph. Don't make a big deal of it.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.compliment.bad.0: Cut it out. You sound like the girls at school.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.ask.good.0: My grandpa dragged me into this. Not that I'd let him go alone.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.ask.good.1: I locked myself in a jail cell once because I thought I was possessed. Turned out it was my Stand.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.vent.good.0: The old man won't stop yelling about everything. And Polnareff keeps wandering off. ...Thanks for listening.
npc.jojoha.talk.jotaro.vent.good.1: Every place we go, someone tries to kill us. It gets old. ...I feel a little better.
npc.jojoha.joseph.greet: Well, hello there! The name's Joseph Joestar. Your next line is "nice to meet you!"
npc.jojoha.joseph.vampire: Oh no, no, no. I know that smell. You stay right there, buddy.
npc.jojoha.joseph.busy: Little busy here! Try me later!
npc.jojoha.joseph.bye: See you around! Don't do anything I wouldn't do. Which isn't much!
npc.jojoha.joseph.stand: Hermit Purple! It's vines. It can take spirit photos. ...Okay, it's not the flashiest, but it's useful!
npc.jojoha.joseph.dio: Dio's been a pain for my family for a hundred years. We're ending it this time. That's a Joestar promise.
npc.jojoha.joseph.greet_friend: Hey, my favourite person! Come here, come here, I've got a story for you!
npc.jojoha.talk.open.joseph: Talking? Oh, I'm great at talking! What's up?
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.joseph.0: Whew, I'm not as young as I used to be. Let's pick this up tomorrow!
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.joseph.1: My throat's dry! I need a Coca-Cola before I say another word.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.chat.good.0: Ha! You know, that reminds me of something that happened in New York...
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.chat.good.1: Exactly! See, you get it. Most people don't.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.chat.bad.0: Uh-huh, uh-huh... sorry, what was that?
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.joke.good.0: HA! Oh, that's great! I'm stealing that one!
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.joke.good.1: Ahahaha! Okay, okay, my turn next!
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.joke.bad.0: Hm. Needs work. Watch the master sometime.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.joke.bad.1: Oof. I've told worse. Not many, though.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.compliment.good.0: Ha! I know, right? Still got it!
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.compliment.good.1: Why, thank you! I keep in shape. Mostly.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.compliment.bad.0: Oh-ho, buttering me up? What do you want?
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.ask.good.0: I trained Hamon on an island with a very strict teacher. Very strict. Best time of my life, though.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.ask.good.1: I've got a grandson who never smiles and a daughter I'd do anything for. That's why I'm here.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.ask.bad.0: Ah, ancient history! Let's talk about something fun!
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.ask.bad.1: Nah, nah, my life story would take all day.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.game.good.0: Rock, paper, scissors! ...You picked rock, didn't you? I knew it! Again!
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.game.good.1: Ha! You won? You must have cheated. I'd know, I always cheat. Rematch!
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.game.bad.0: Not now, I'm saving my luck for later.
npc.jojoha.talk.joseph.game.bad.1: Hmm, I've got a feeling you'd beat me today. Maybe tomorrow!
npc.jojoha.avdol.greet: Greetings. Mind yourself here, Dio's servants could be anywhere.
npc.jojoha.avdol.vampire: I can sense what you are. I will not speak with you. Leave.
npc.jojoha.avdol.busy: Stand back! This one is dangerous.
npc.jojoha.avdol.bye: Take care. May the cards be kind to you.
npc.jojoha.avdol.stand: Magician's Red. It is a spirit of fire. I have trained with it for many years, and I respect its power.
npc.jojoha.avdol.dio: Dio is the most dangerous being I have ever sensed. We must not underestimate him, not even for a moment.
npc.jojoha.avdol.greet_friend: Ah, my friend. I had a feeling you would come today.
npc.jojoha.talk.open.avdol: Of course. What is on your mind?
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.avdol.0: We have spoken a great deal today. Let us rest and continue tomorrow.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.avdol.1: I must meditate now. Come and see me again tomorrow.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.chat.good.1: Yes. That is worth thinking about.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.chat.bad.0: I see. Is there a point to this?
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.joke.good.1: Heh. Polnareff would like that one.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.joke.bad.0: This is not a time for jokes.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.joke.bad.1: I do not find that funny.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.compliment.good.0: Thank you. I have worked hard for many years.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.compliment.good.1: You are kind. I try to live up to it.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.compliment.bad.1: Words are cheap. Show me with actions.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.ask.good.0: I am a fortune teller from Cairo. I met Mr. Joestar years ago, and I owe him a great deal.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.ask.good.1: My Stand has been with me since birth. I have always known it was meant for something important.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.ask.bad.1: Some things are best kept to oneself.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.advice.good.0: Never fight angry. Fire burns the one who cannot control it.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.advice.good.1: Read your enemy before you strike. Every Stand has a weakness.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.advice.bad.0: You are not ready to hear it yet.
npc.jojoha.talk.avdol.advice.bad.1: The cards are unclear today. Ask me again.
npc.jojoha.kakyoin.greet: Oh. Hello. Be careful around here, it's not safe.
npc.jojoha.kakyoin.vampire: I know what you are. I was under Dio's control once. Never again. Leave.
npc.jojoha.kakyoin.stand: Hierophant Green. It can stretch itself out like a thread and fire emeralds. I've had it all my life.
npc.jojoha.kakyoin.dio: He put a flesh bud in my head and made me his puppet. I owe the Joestars my life for getting it out.
npc.jojoha.kakyoin.greet_friend: Ah, it's you. I was hoping you'd stop by.
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.kakyoin.0: I think I'd like some time to myself now. Tomorrow?
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.kakyoin.1: I've said more today than I usually do in a week.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.chat.good.0: Yes, I think so too. It's easy to talk to you.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.chat.good.1: Heh. I've never had many people to talk to like this.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.chat.bad.1: I'd rather not get into that right now.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.joke.bad.0: Hm. Not really my kind of humour.
Oh. Thank you. That's kind of you.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.compliment.bad.0: You don't need to say things like that.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.compliment.bad.1: Please don't. It makes me uncomfortable.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.ask.good.0: When I was young, nobody could see my Stand. I felt alone for a long time.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.ask.good.1: I like cherries. And video games. Is that strange?
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.ask.bad.0: I'd rather keep that to myself.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.ask.bad.1: It's not something I talk about.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.company.good.0: ...Thank you for staying. It's nice, having someone who understands.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.company.good.1: We don't have to say anything. This is enough.
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.company.bad.0: Um, are you going to say something?
npc.jojoha.talk.kakyoin.company.bad.1: I think I'd like to be alone right now.
npc.jojoha.polnareff.greet: Bonjour! Jean Pierre Polnareff, finest swordsman in all of France. Pleased to meet me?
npc.jojoha.polnareff.vampire: Ugh, you reek of the undead. Stay back, or Silver Chariot cuts you to pieces!
npc.jojoha.polnareff.bye: Au revoir! Try not to miss me too much!
npc.jojoha.polnareff.stand: Silver Chariot! The fastest blade you'll ever see. If you blink, you'll miss it.
npc.jojoha.polnareff.dio: One of Dio's men killed my sister. I'm going to find him, and then Dio. That's my promise to her.
npc.jojoha.polnareff.greet_friend: Ah, mon ami! You've come to see me again. Of course you have!
npc.jojoha.talk.open.polnareff: Ah, you want to talk to me? Smart choice!
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.polnareff.0: Even the great Polnareff needs a rest. Come back tomorrow!
npc.jojoha.talk.tired.polnareff.1: That's enough for today. I have to look after my hair.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.chat.good.0: Oui, oui, exactly what I was thinking.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.chat.good.1: Ha! You're alright, you know that?
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.joke.good.0: HAHA! That's great! Not as good as mine, but great!
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.joke.good.1: Hah! You're funny! Almost as funny as me.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.joke.bad.0: Was that a joke? In France, we'd call that a tragedy.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.joke.bad.1: Hm. I've heard better from Jotaro. And he doesn't tell jokes.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.compliment.goo: Merci! Finally, someone with good taste!
I know, I know. But keep going!
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.compliment.bad: Only that? You must not have seen my swordplay.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.ask.good.0: I grew up in France with my little sister. She was the kindest person I ever knew.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.ask.good.1: I've trained with Silver Chariot since I was a boy. Ten years of practice, every day.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.ask.bad.0: Ah, a man must have some mystery!
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.ask.bad.1: Not today. Ask me again when I'm in the mood.
Watch this! See? I sliced the falling leaf into five pieces before it hit the ground!
Voilà! Silver Chariot's speed is unmatched. Applause is welcome.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.show_off.bad.0: Not now, I'm not warmed up.
npc.jojoha.talk.polnareff.show_off.bad.1: A true artist doesn't perform on demand.
npc.jojoha.trait.locked: Their personality (get to know them first)
npc.jojoha.gift.hold: Give a gift (hold an item first)
commands.jojoha.event.status.none: No world event is running. It is day %s; events can roll from day %s.
npc.jojoha.bond.not_yet: I don't know you well enough for that yet.
npc.jojoha.bond.no_room: I'd need a free bed near here, with a door and some light. I'm not sleeping in the dark.
npc.jojoha.bond.settled: That'll do nicely. Thanks, I'll make myself at home.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.bounty.spotted: %s! Thought I'd find you sooner or later.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.bounty.again: %s. You again? You should have stayed down last time.
npc.jojoha.stand_user.awakened.greet: I'm still getting used to this thing. It follows me everywhere, you know?
town.jojoha.reply.deliver: I've got a letter for you.
town.jojoha.task.cannot: Hm, that one won't work right now. Maybe another time.
town.jojoha.task.none: Nothing needs doing right now. Check back tomorrow.
town.jojoha.rumour.none: Haven't heard anything new. Ask me another day.
town.jojoha.ask.people: Who do you get on with?
town.jojoha.greet.cold: I've got nothing to say to you.
town.jojoha.greet.ravaged: We lost a lot of people in that raid. What do you need?
town.jojoha.greet.friend: Oh, it's you! Good to see you.
town.jojoha.greet.cheerful: Hi there! Lovely day, isn't it?
town.jojoha.greet.proud: You've come to the right person. What do you need?
town.jojoha.greet.curious: Hey, you're not from around here, are you?
town.jojoha.repair.nothing: That doesn't need fixing. Hold the thing you want fixed.
town.jojoha.repair.offer.1: I can fix that for one emerald.
town.jojoha.repair.offer.2: I can fix that for two emeralds.
town.jojoha.repair.offer.3: I can fix that for three emeralds.
town.jojoha.repair.offer.4: I can fix that for four emeralds.
town.jojoha.repair.offer.5: I can fix that for five emeralds.
town.jojoha.repair.offer.6: I can fix that for six emeralds.
town.jojoha.repair.broke: You don't have enough emeralds for that.
town.jojoha.heal.offer.free: Hold still, I'll patch you up. No charge for a friend.
town.jojoha.heal.offer.paid: I can patch you up for an emerald.
town.jojoha.heal.done: That should stop the bleeding. Take it easy for a bit.
town.jojoha.town.ravaged: Honestly? Not great. Half of us are gone. It'll take a while to get back on our feet.
town.jojoha.town.growing: We've got a few empty beds. New folks show up every now and then, though.
town.jojoha.town.thriving: Busy as ever. There's always someone new around.
town.jojoha.town.quiet: Quiet. Nothing much happens here, and that's how I like it.
town.jojoha.people.friend: Pretty much everyone. We look out for each other here.
town.jojoha.people.rival: Most people, sure. There's one I can't stand, though. Don't get me started.
town.jojoha.news.none: Nothing worth mentioning. It's been quiet.
town.jojoha.news.meteor: Did you see the shooting stars the other night? People say some of them actually hit the ground.
town.jojoha.news.raid_won: A town nearby got raided by vampires. They fought them off, thank goodness.
town.jojoha.news.raid_lost: Vampires overran a town not far from here. Half of them didn't make it.
town.jojoha.news.recovered: The town that got raided is back on its feet. Good for them.
town.jojoha.news.arrow: Someone got hit by a stray arrow, and now there's this... ghost thing standing behind them. Weird, right?
town.jojoha.news.vampire_night: That red moon was awful. I didn't sleep a wink.
town.jojoha.rep.disliked: People in %s don't like you much.
town.jojoha.rep.neutral: People in %s don't have strong feelings about you.
town.jojoha.rep.loved: People in %s think the world of you.
town.jojoha.market: It's market day! A trader has set up shop in %s.
town.jojoha.arrive.0: Hi! I'm new here. Is there a free bed somewhere?
town.jojoha.arrive.1: Phew, long walk. Mind if I settle in?
town.jojoha.arrive.2: Heard this place could use a few more hands.
town.jojoha.arrive.3: Hello! I'm moving in. Nice to meet everyone.
town.jojoha.arrow.friendly: Someone in %s got hit by a stray arrow, and now a Stand is standing behind them. They seem friendly enough.
town.jojoha.arrow.rogue: Someone in %s got hit by a stray arrow and awakened a Stand. They ran off, and they looked angry.
town.jojoha.turned.back: The people taken from %s are back. They're not themselves anymore.
town.jojoha.ravaged: %s was overrun. Half the town is gone.
town.jojoha.chatter.1: Did you hear about the shooting stars?
town.jojoha.chatter.2: I swear the bread's gotten smaller.
town.jojoha.chatter.3: Can't believe it's this hot already.
town.jojoha.chatter.4: Have you seen my bucket anywhere?
town.jojoha.chatter.5: The golem's been acting funny again.
town.jojoha.chatter.6: I'm thinking of planting more carrots this year.
town.jojoha.chatter.8: Saw a stranger on the road this morning.
town.jojoha.chatter.9: Don't stay out after dark, alright?
town.jojoha.chatter.11: Someone's been leaving the gate open.
town.jojoha.argue.0: You borrowed my hoe and never gave it back!
town.jojoha.argue.1: That's my spot. It's always been my spot.
town.jojoha.argue.3: Your chickens got into my garden again.
town.jojoha.theft.1: Excuse me? Get out of there.
town.jojoha.theft.2: I saw that. Don't think I didn't.
town.jojoha.witness.1: Vampire! There's a vampire in town!
town.jojoha.witness.2: Oh no. Oh no no no.
quest.jojoha.nowhere: They can't quite remember where it was. Try again later.
quest.jojoha.rescue.found: Found them. Get them out of there!
quest.jojoha.hamon_master.title: Hamon Master
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.arrived: This is it! Thanks for walking me here.
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.name: Pilgrim Escort
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.goal: Walk the pilgrim to the next town
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.offer: I'm heading to the next town over, but the roads aren't safe. Would you walk with me?
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.taken: Great. I'll follow you. Don't go too fast.
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.progress: Are we there yet? Just kidding. Mostly.
quest.jojoha.pilgrim_escort.done: We made it. Thank you so much.
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.name: Night Watch
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.goal: Fight off the vampires that come tonight
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student who trusts you.
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.track: Wait for the vampires and fight them
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.offer: Vampires have been sniffing around here at night. Keep watch with me tonight? If you do well, I'll put in a word for you.
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.taken: Stay close. They'll show up once it's dark.
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.progress: They're still out there. Keep your eyes open.
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.done: That's all of them. You fight better than I thought.
quest.jojoha.camp_watch.thanks: I'll tell the others about you. Here.
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.name: Breathing Trial
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.goal: Hold your breath underwater for %s seconds in total
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.giver: Asked by a Hamon Student who trusts you.
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.offer: Everyone starts with breathing. If you can hold your breath under water for a while, I'll give you my old book. It's how I learned.
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.taken: Find some water and stay under. It doesn't have to be all at once.
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.progress: Keep practising. Your lungs will get used to it.
quest.jojoha.hermit_breath.thanks: Here's the Hermit Path Book. Read it when you're ready. Take care of it.
quest.jojoha.town_pantry.name: Stock the Pantry
quest.jojoha.town_pantry.return: Bring the bread to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.town_pantry.offer: Our pantry's nearly empty. Could you bring us ten loaves of bread?
quest.jojoha.town_pantry.taken: Thanks! Any farm should have wheat.
quest.jojoha.town_pantry.thanks: Here, take this for your trouble.
quest.jojoha.pest_control.name: Pest Control
quest.jojoha.pest_control.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.pest_control.offer: The dead keep wandering in at night. Could you thin them out a bit? Eight should do it.
quest.jojoha.pest_control.progress: There are still plenty of them around.
quest.jojoha.pest_control.done: It's been a lot quieter. Thank you.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.name: Timber for Rebuilding
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.giver: Asked by a villager after a raid.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.return: Bring the logs to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.offer: The raid wrecked half our houses. If we had some logs, we could fix a few up and make room for new people.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.taken: Thank you. Any kind of wood will do.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.done: That's plenty. We can start fixing things now.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_timber.thanks: Someone new might move in thanks to you. Here.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_bread.name: Feeding the Survivors
quest.jojoha.rebuild_bread.giver: Asked by a villager after a raid.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_bread.return: Bring the bread to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.rebuild_bread.offer: We've barely got any food left since the raid. Could you bring some bread?
quest.jojoha.rebuild_bread.done: This will keep us going. Thank you.
quest.jojoha.rebuild_bread.thanks: Here. It isn't much, but take it.
quest.jojoha.night_watch.name: Keep Watch
quest.jojoha.night_watch.goal: Fight off the vampires that come tonight
quest.jojoha.night_watch.track: Wait for the vampires and fight them
quest.jojoha.night_watch.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.night_watch.offer: Something's been prowling around at night. Would you keep watch tonight?
quest.jojoha.night_watch.done: You chased them off? We can finally sleep.
quest.jojoha.letter_run.name: Letter Run
quest.jojoha.letter_run.goal: Take the letter to the next town
quest.jojoha.letter_run.return: Give the letter to any villager in that town
quest.jojoha.letter_run.offer: Could you take a letter to the next town over? My sister lives there.
quest.jojoha.letter_run.taken: Thanks! Anyone there will know her.
quest.jojoha.letter_run.progress: Did you deliver my letter yet?
quest.jojoha.letter_run.done: A letter? For me? Oh, it's from my sister!
quest.jojoha.letter_run.thanks: Thank you for bringing this all the way here. Take this.
quest.jojoha.stranger_on_the_road.name: Stranger on the Road
quest.jojoha.stranger_on_the_road.goal: Look around where the travellers were attacked
quest.jojoha.stranger_on_the_road.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.stranger_on_the_road.offer: Travellers keep getting attacked out on the road. They say the attacker had some kind of ghost with them. Could you take a look?
quest.jojoha.stranger_on_the_road.taken: It happened over that way. Be careful.
quest.jojoha.stranger_on_the_road.done: So it's a Stand User. I knew it.
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.name: A Stranger with a Stand
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.goal: Beat the Stand User in a duel
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.retur: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.offer: That Stand User is back and wants a fight. Will you take them on?
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.progr: They're still around, waiting for you.
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.done: You beat them? They won't bother anyone now.
quest.jojoha.stranger_with_a_stand.thank: Everyone's going to hear about this. Here.
quest.jojoha.wanted.name: Wanted
quest.jojoha.wanted.goal: Take down the wanted Stand User
quest.jojoha.wanted.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.wanted.offer: There's an outlaw with a Stand out there. They've hurt a lot of people. There's a reward if you stop them.
quest.jojoha.wanted.progress: Still out there, last I heard.
quest.jojoha.wanted.thanks: Here's the reward. You earned every bit of it.
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.name: The Mask Collector
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.giver: Asked by a villager who trusts you.
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.return: Bring the mask to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.offer: Someone's been asking around for stone masks. Creepy things. If you find one, bring it to me and I'll make sure it gets destroyed.
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.taken: Thank you. Those masks are bad news.
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.done: Is that it? Give it here. Nobody should ever wear that thing.
quest.jojoha.mask_collector.kept: ...Fine. But don't come crying to me when something goes wrong.
quest.jojoha.stones_from_the_sky.name: Stones from the Sky
quest.jojoha.stones_from_the_sky.giver: Asked by a villager after a meteor shower.
quest.jojoha.stones_from_the_sky.return: Bring the scrap to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.stones_from_the_sky.offer: Some of those shooting stars landed nearby. Could you bring me a few pieces? I'll trade you a map that shows where more of them are.
quest.jojoha.stones_from_the_sky.done: These are amazing! Look at them!
quest.jojoha.missing_children.name: Missing Children
quest.jojoha.missing_children.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.missing_children.offer: Kids have been going missing near the old orphanage. Nobody's brave enough to go look. Would you?
quest.jojoha.missing_children.progress: Have you been to the orphanage yet?
quest.jojoha.missing_children.done: Vampires? Oh no. They must have the kids.
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.name: Bring Them Home
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.track: Find the kid and kill the vampires holding them
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.offer: We know where they're keeping one of the kids now. Please, bring them home.
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.taken: There'll be vampires guarding them. Be careful.
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.done: You saved them! I can't thank you enough.
quest.jojoha.bring_them_home.thanks: Please, take this. It's the least we can do.
quest.jojoha.taken_at_night.name: Taken at Night
quest.jojoha.taken_at_night.giver: Asked by a villager who trusts you.
quest.jojoha.taken_at_night.track: Find the villager and kill the vampires holding them
quest.jojoha.taken_at_night.return: Return to any villager in town
quest.jojoha.taken_at_night.offer: One of us was dragged off last night. They might still be alive. Will you find them?
quest.jojoha.rumour_catacombs.name: The Old Catacombs
quest.jojoha.rumour_catacombs.return: Tell any villager what you found
quest.jojoha.rumour_catacombs.offer: There's an old crypt somewhere around here. People say there's treasure down there, and worse things too.
quest.jojoha.rumour_catacombs.taken: It's out that way, I think. Let me know what you find.
quest.jojoha.rumour_catacombs.done: So it's real! What was it like?
quest.jojoha.rumour_farmhouse.name: The Bloody Farmhouse
quest.jojoha.rumour_farmhouse.return: Tell any villager what you found
quest.jojoha.rumour_farmhouse.offer: There's a farmhouse nobody goes near anymore. Something bad happened there.
quest.jojoha.rumour_farmhouse.taken: It's out that way, I think. Let me know what you find.
quest.jojoha.rumour_farmhouse.done: So it's real! What was it like?
quest.jojoha.rumour_castle.name: The Little Castle
quest.jojoha.rumour_castle.return: Tell any villager what you found
quest.jojoha.rumour_castle.offer: Someone built a little castle out in the wilds. Never seen who lives there.
quest.jojoha.rumour_castle.taken: It's out that way, I think. Let me know what you find.
quest.jojoha.rumour_castle.done: So it's real! What was it like?
quest.jojoha.rumour_shack.name: The Shack
quest.jojoha.rumour_shack.return: Tell any villager what you found
quest.jojoha.rumour_shack.offer: There's a shack out there where a strange man used to live. Nobody's seen him in years.
quest.jojoha.rumour_shack.taken: It's out that way, I think. Let me know what you find.
quest.jojoha.rumour_shack.done: So it's real! What was it like?
quest.jojoha.rumour_willow.name: The Willow House
quest.jojoha.rumour_willow.return: Tell any villager what you found
quest.jojoha.rumour_willow.offer: There's a house under a big willow tree. Gives me the creeps every time I pass it.
quest.jojoha.rumour_willow.taken: It's out that way, I think. Let me know what you find.
quest.jojoha.rumour_willow.done: So it's real! What was it like?
quest.jojoha.rumour_orphanage.name: The Old Orphanage
quest.jojoha.rumour_orphanage.return: Tell any villager what you found
quest.jojoha.rumour_orphanage.offer: There's an old orphanage out in the moors. Empty now, or so they say.
quest.jojoha.rumour_orphanage.taken: It's out that way, I think. Let me know what you find.
quest.jojoha.rumour_orphanage.done: So it's real! What was it like?
quest.jojoha.first_taste.name: First Taste
quest.jojoha.first_taste.offer: You're new. You still smell like one of them. Go and feed. Three should do.
quest.jojoha.first_taste.taken: Sneak up on them. Don't let anyone see.
quest.jojoha.first_taste.progress: You're still hungry. I can tell.
quest.jojoha.first_taste.done: Better. You look like one of us now.
quest.jojoha.hunters_hunted.name: Hunters Hunted
quest.jojoha.hunters_hunted.offer: Those breathing freaks keep killing our kind. Kill two of them.
quest.jojoha.hunters_hunted.taken: Their punches burn. Don't let them hit you.
quest.jojoha.scout_the_town.name: Scout the Town
quest.jojoha.scout_the_town.offer: There's a village somewhere near here. Find it, and tell me how many of them live there.
quest.jojoha.scout_the_town.taken: Go at night. Stay out of the light.
quest.jojoha.scout_the_town.done: Plenty of them. Good. Very good.
quest.jojoha.loose_ends.name: Loose Ends
quest.jojoha.loose_ends.offer: Some of the villagers saw us. Deal with two of them. At night, where nobody's watching.
quest.jojoha.night_feast.name: Night Feast
quest.jojoha.night_feast.giver: Asked by a vampire Sire during a Vampire Night.
quest.jojoha.night_feast.offer: The moon's red tonight. Everyone's out. Feed as much as you can.
quest.jojoha.night_feast.done: You look strong. That's how it should be.
quest.jojoha.hamon_master.name: The Hamon Master
quest.jojoha.hamon_master.offer: The students have a teacher out there. Kill the teacher and the rest will scatter.
quest.jojoha.hamon_master.taken: They're stronger than the students. Be careful.
quest.jojoha.hamon_master.done: Dead? Ha! They'll be lost without them.
quest.jojoha.hamon_master.thanks: You're one of us now. Take this.
quest.jojoha.sires_raid.name: The Sire's Raid
quest.jojoha.sires_raid.goal: Help the vampires overrun a town
quest.jojoha.sires_raid.offer: The village you found. Tonight, we take it. Are you with us?
quest.jojoha.sires_raid.taken: Then let's go. Stay close to the bell.
quest.jojoha.sires_raid.done: The town is ours. Well done.
quest.jojoha.sires_raid.thanks: This is yours. You earned it.
vampire_npc.jojoha.reply.coven: Where do I stand with the coven?
vampire_npc.jojoha.task.cannot: That won't work right now. Come back later.
vampire_npc.jojoha.task.none: Nothing for you right now. Come back another night.
vampire_npc.jojoha.task.ask_sire: I don't give orders. Go find a Sire.
vampire_npc.jojoha.talk.open: You want to talk? Fine. Make it quick.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.stalker: Hm? You're one of us. What do you want?
vampire_npc.jojoha.hunger.stalker: Slim pickings. They lock their doors at night now.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.ripper: You've got blood on you. Not enough, though.
vampire_npc.jojoha.hunger.ripper: I tore one up last night. Felt great.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.sire: A new one. Come closer. Let me look at you.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.sire.close: My favourite. What do you need?
vampire_npc.jojoha.hunger.sire: My zombies are hungry. So am I. Always.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.frost: Don't stand so close. It's cold enough.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.frost.close: You again. I don't mind it.
vampire_npc.jojoha.hunger.frost: Their blood freezes before I even finish. It's annoying.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.ravager: What? You want something? Spit it out.
vampire_npc.jojoha.greet.ravager.close: Ha! It's you. Want to go smash something?
vampire_npc.jojoha.hunger.ravager: Smashed a door down yesterday. Best part of my week.
vampire_npc.jojoha.coven.hated: The coven wants you dead. I'd watch my back if I were you.
vampire_npc.jojoha.coven.neutral: You're nobody yet. Do something worth noticing.
vampire_npc.jojoha.coven.friendly: People are starting to talk about you. Good things, mostly.
vampire_npc.jojoha.coven.honoured: Everyone knows your name. Even the Sires respect you.
